Job Description

eDiscovery Project Manager

Drive Operational Excellence

At Ashurst Perkins Coie US LLP

, our people are our greatest asset. We’re looking for a collaborative, detail-oriented eDiscovery Project Manager to join our team and help deliver an exceptional employee experience.

In this role, the eDiscovery Project Manager

is a trusted advisor who delivers strategic, technology-driven solutions that support case teams, clients, and matter success. This role leads matter management and applies innovative legal technologies to streamline workflows, solve complex challenges, and advance case objectives. Working collaboratively with Senior Project Managers, Consulting Managers, Practice Attorneys, Project Coordinators, Data Transformation Analysts, and legal professionals across the firm, the Project Manager drives efficient, client-focused outcomes through expertise, partnership, and innovation.

What You’ll Do

Advise legal teams and clients on the strategic use of legal technologies, including AI, to solve complex legal challenges and enhance matter outcomes.
Serve as the primary NewLaw contact, managing matters from initiation through successful delivery.
Lead multiple projects simultaneously, balancing priorities, timelines, budgets, risks, and evolving scope.
Coordinate cross-functional teams and external partners supporting forensics, analytics, review, trial readiness, and other litigation services.
Apply deep expertise in legal technology platforms, including Relativity, DISCO, and Everchron, to deliver efficient, high-quality solutions.
Oversee database design, data transformation, document productions, and other critical matter management activities.
Define technical requirements, manage deliverables, ensure quality assurance, and validate production accuracy, including privilege, redactions, conflict coding, and family relationships.
Communicate proactively with stakeholders on project status, milestones, risks, costs, and scope changes.
Stay current on emerging legal technologies and champion best practices and continuous improvement across the firm.
Support business development initiatives, including client presentations, and maintain availability to meet firm and client needs.

What You’ll Bring

Bachelor’s degree and at least 3 years of related work experience. Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be substituted.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrates expertise in legal practice technologies, including Generative AI, with exceptional project and matter management skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive under tight deadlines.
An innovative problem-solver and trusted client partner, this individual communicates effectively, exercises sound judgment, and takes initiative with minimal supervision.
Proficiency in Relativity and/or DISCO, along with the ability to quickly master emerging litigation technologies, is essential.
Prior experience in litigation or e-discovery project management is strongly preferred.

Why Join Ashurst Perkins Coie?

Join a collaborative, high-performing Project Management team where your expertise will help shape the employee experience across our global organization. In this role, if you are passionate about delivering exceptional service and making a lasting impact, you will find meaningful opportunities to grow your career while helping create an outstanding experience for our people.

This position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, 401(k) plan, medical, dental, and vision insurance, accrued paid time off plan starting at 20 days annually, personal medical and parental leave, up to 10 paid holidays, and family care benefits. More information regarding benefits and programs may be found here .

jobs.description:
About Empire & Co.

Empire & Co. is one of the largest commercial furniture dealerships in the United States, with more than 80 years of experience delivering innovative workplace solutions. With approximately 565 employees, Empire & Co. partners with Steelcase and more than 500 manufacturers to provide comprehensive furniture solutions for organizations across the country. The company combines design, project management, installation, and workplace expertise to create spaces that support the way people work today and into the future.

Overview

Empire Office is currently seeking a Project Manager to join our growing team. The function of this position is to provide direct oversight to each Project from beginning stages of budgeting to close out with the client. This position is highly interactive and is responsible for on-site delivery and installation management for all furniture, fixtures, and equipment (FFE) items. This role is responsible for monitoring and communicating with all necessary vendors for each step of a given project to make sure that we meet and exceed the customer’s expectation.

Key Responsibilities

Review all FFE items and coordinate with Client or architects
Consisting of Film/Signage/Furniture/Vending/Plants/Accessories/Supplies
Review client needs on project-by-project basis
Receive project kickoff information
Attend kick-off meeting with client team in person as needed, or remotely
Attend project meetings, construction meetings and conference calls
Establish milestone dates for all vendors
Develop preliminary delivery and installation schedule for all FFE Vendors
Coordinate field verification of critical demands
Coordinate deliveries with General Contractor, trades workers and building management for all FFE vendors (i.e. elevators)
Request and assemble installation documents and provide installation books
Spot check order and counts
Check all incoming deliveries to ensure accuracy of product
Coordinate with electrician and data on site
Make sure the site is maintained and any excess product is managed appropriately
Continually monitor site and the progress of the job
Troubleshoot any on site issues
Bring back any additional work orders from the field and work with Sales and Operations
Coordinate training with manufacturers on proper use of furniture
Prepare punch list and submit verification of the resolution on all items
Coordinate and schedule all punch issues for FFE vendors
Establish and attend furniture walk through
Duties could include helping with placement/staging of accessory items
Coordinate with client on final closeout or project

Qualifications

Skills & Qualifications

Minimum 5 years work experience in facility management, design, or related office furniture experience
Technical / professional training or two-year degree
Proven organizational and follow through skills
Proficient Microsoft Office knowledge (Outlook/Excel/Word)
Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
Ability to work effectively in a team environment
Ability to work hours as needed to support team and meet customer expectations
Possesses strong interpersonal skills
Proficient with mathematical disciplines
Ability to read and understand construction drawings, furniture spec plans or other architectural drawings
Ability to analyze problem solve and make decisions following company protocols
Ability to travel on as a needed basis

jobs.description:
Company Description
CB TEAM operates in the payment industry, focusing on building secure, efficient, and scalable technology solutions that support modern digital transactions. The organization works closely with clients and partners to streamline payment workflows and improve customer experiences. CB TEAM values innovation, reliability, and collaboration, creating an environment where technical and operational teams work together to solve complex problems. Team members are encouraged to experiment with new technologies, including AI and machine learning, to optimize payment operations and deliver measurable business impact.
Role Description
The AI/ML Program Manager (GenAI, LLM Operations, Data Annotation, SFT, RLHF) is a full-time remote role responsible for overseeing end-to-end delivery of AI and large language model initiatives that support CB TEAM’s payment solutions. This role coordinates cross-functional stakeholders, defines program scope, timelines, and success metrics, and ensures that GenAI and LLM-based capabilities are developed and deployed reliably. Day-to-day tasks include managing data annotation pipelines, supervising supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) workflows, and aligning operational processes with model performance and safety requirements. The Program Manager will manage vendor and partner relationships, track risks and dependencies, and maintain documentation and reporting for executive and technical audiences. The role also involves continuous improvement of AI operations, implementing best practices for model evaluation, compliance, and user experience in production environments.
Qualifications

Experience managing AI/ML programs, including GenAI and LLM initiatives, with a strong understanding of end-to-end model lifecycles (requirements, development, deployment, monitoring).
Background in LLM operations, including model orchestration, evaluation, safety, prompt management, and performance optimization in production environments.
Hands-on experience with data annotation workflows, including guideline design, annotator management, quality assurance, and tooling for labeled datasets.
Knowledge of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and RLHF processes, including experiment design, feedback collection, and collaboration with ML engineers and data scientists.
Strong program and project management skills: planning, prioritization, roadmap ownership, risk management, stakeholder communication, and status reporting.
Familiarity with payment or fintech domains, or other regulated industries, including awareness of security, privacy, and compliance considerations for AI systems.
Ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed environment, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and a collaborative, inclusive mindset.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, or a related field; equivalent practical experience in AI/ML program management is also valued.
Experience working with AI platforms, MLOps tools, or cloud

We are looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and relentless Marketing Project Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our marketing team. Reporting directly to leadership, you will keep priorities crystal clear, projects moving effortlessly, and cross-functional teams held strictly accountable.

This role is for a natural systems builder who takes total ownership, obsessively manages details, and anticipates friction points long before they impact delivery. If you thrive on bringing order to fast-moving creative environments and driving projects across the finish line with precision and zero hand-holding, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Operational Backbone: Serve as the central engine for marketing ops, maintaining project timelines, keeping priorities aligned, and holding stakeholders accountable to strict deadlines.
Systems & Process Architecture: Build, document, and refine scalable workflows, team structures, and project management architectures from scratch.
Proactive Oversight & Blocker Clearance: Identify potential bottlenecks early, set firm expectations across departments, and drive relentless follow-through without waiting for direction or management nudges.
Project Tracking & Execution: Oversee creative, marketing, and cross-functional deliverables from initial brief to final asset deployment, ensuring zero details slip through the cracks.
Tools & Platform Ownership: Build, structure, and maintain workspace architecture within project management suites (ClickUp, Notion, Asana) to streamline team communication and asset tracking.
Leadership Alignment: Partner directly with marketing leadership to translate high-level strategy into structured, actionable project plans and clear daily workflows.
Cross-Channel Project Management: Manage projects across email and SMS, retention and lifecycle marketing, e-commerce, and brand initiatives, coordinating timelines, dependencies, and handoffs to keep campaigns and launches on track.

Required Skills And Qualifications

Uncompromising Precision: Exceptional organizational habits, relentless follow-through, and a proactive mindset that creates clarity amidst rapid growth.
Proven Systems Track Record: Demonstrated experience building operational frameworks, SOPs, and cross-functional team structures from scratch (with concrete examples of systems implemented).
Technical Proficiency: Deep working knowledge of project management software (ClickUp, Notion, Asana, Slack) and experience organizing complex asset libraries.
Independent Accountability: Comfortable setting clear expectations, following up consistently across teams, and driving projects forward independently.
Communication: Exceptional business communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to manage up and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned.
Marketing Workflow Proficiency: Strong understanding of email and SMS campaign production, retention and lifecycle workflows, e-commerce updates, and brand creative development. Able to translate briefs into clear tasks, owners, deadlines, and approval processes across these functions.

Background in CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) or the Beauty / Wellness industry within a fast-paced marketing department.
Experience working within a digital agency or high-growth DTC e-commerce environment.

jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

YOUR IMPACT

Are you passionate about delivering exceptional service and solving complex challenges at the intersection of law and technology? As a Project Manager for OpenText’s LegalTech team, you will lead client engagements from kickoff to billing, ensuring seamless execution and strategic outcomes. In this high-impact role, you will work with law firms, corporate legal departments, and review partners to bring clarity, precision, and excellence to every phase of the eDiscovery lifecycle.

This is a dynamic opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, values client relationships, and enjoys collaborating across teams to make a real difference in the legal tech space.

YOU ARE GREAT AT

Lead strategic client engagements: act as the primary consultant for assigned matters, guiding projects from initial proposal through final invoicing while delivering outstanding service and value.

Deliver client-centric solutions: consult with clients to understand goals, propose effective workflows, and proactively manage challenges. Build trust through responsiveness, insight, and consistency.

Collaborate across teams: partner with internal departments, corporate legal teams, and law firms to align efforts, ensure quality, and meet case-specific objectives.

Manage end-to-end discovery tasks: oversee technical workflows including data processing, user and case setup, and production execution to support client deadlines and goals.

Contribute to team success: support unassigned or escalated projects when needed. Maintain thorough documentation of project activity, custom workflows, and client communications.

Drive innovation and efficiency: identify opportunities for process improvements and implement technical or procedural solutions that enhance service quality and delivery speed.

You are highly organized and detail oriented. You have the ability to balance multiple complex projects without losing track of deliverables, deadlines, or dependencies.

You are intellectually curious and thrive on solving complex problems with precision and creativity.

You communicate clearly, whether you are guiding a client, coaching a team member, or breaking down technical concepts.

Proven experience managing complex projects and delivering client-facing services in deadline-driven environments.

Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical concepts clearly to legal and non-technical audiences.

Familiarity with the evolving role of artificial intelligence in eDiscovery.

Ability to work cross-functionally and collaborate effectively with internal teams, external partners, and clients.

Experience with OpenText eDiscovery (formerly Axcelerate) is a strong plus.

Requirements may dictate the necessity to work hours outside of normal, 40-hour workweek.

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. PSO Program Manager, Community Connect
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact
Axon Community Connect enables public safety agencies to build voluntary, policy-based partnerships with businesses and community members. Through camera registration and secure camera integration, the program expands investigative reach and real-time situational awareness during critical incidents while maintaining privacy, transparency, and camera-owner control.
As the PSO Program Manager, Community Connect, you will lead the operational health and scalable execution of the Community Connect program across Axon’s U.S. customer base and growing international footprint.
You will establish the operating discipline that enables Program Coordinators to deliver consistent agency outcomes. This includes maintaining visibility into program performance, work-order health, delivery dependencies, technical readiness, and customer-impacting risks; strengthening the processes, tools, and playbooks used across the team; and ensuring complex issues receive the appropriate cross-functional attention.
You will serve as a program-level escalation resource, coordinating with Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Finance to remove blockers and drive resolution. You will also provide consultative support for hardware deployment readiness, remote hardware configuration and activation, connectivity, and camera integration requirements.
Your work will enable agencies to launch and sustain Community Connect programs that extend operational visibility, strengthen community participation, and scale responsibly without compromising privacy or the customer experience.
What You’ll Do
Location:
Remote - PT or MT Time Zones 
Travel:
Approximately 30%
Reports to:
Manager, Program Management (Community Connect)
Partner with PSO leadership to implement scalable workflows, operating rhythms, documentation, and reporting that support consistent program delivery.
Maintain visibility into overall program performance, project status, delivery milestones, dependencies, and customer-impacting risks.
Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams to remove delivery blockers, manage escalations, and improve the customer experience.
Support work-order management and closure activities, including quality checks, documentation, and internal handoffs.
Serve as a technical resource for deployment planning, hardware readiness, network connectivity, configuration, and integration requirements.
Support the deployment of Cores placed in the field by Community Connect team members, including remote configuration, activation, validation, and onsite technical support when needed.
Troubleshoot hardware, network, connectivity, and video-integration issues; document findings and coordinate escalation with the appropriate technical resources to drive resolution.
Create and maintain technical readiness guidance, deployment checklists, troubleshooting resources, and escalation paths for common Community Connect deployment scenarios.
Develop and maintain playbooks, training materials, job aids, and knowledge resources that enable consistent team execution.
Identify recurring delivery, technical, and process issues; partner with leadership to implement improvements that strengthen program execution at scale.
Support adoption of new products, internal tools, and program updates by ensuring the team has clear guidance and readiness resources.

What You Bring
Bachelor’s degree in program management, project management, operations, information technology, professional services, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience, including 2+ years supporting customer-facing technical deployments, implementations, or professional-services programs involving remote hardware configuration, activation, troubleshooting, and field deployment coordination.
Working knowledge of hardware, networking, connectivity, and integration concepts—including IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, firewalls, ports, Wi-Fi, bandwidth, and basic troubleshooting—and the ability to translate technical findings into clear next steps.
Experience managing complex, customer-facing work involving multiple stakeholders, dependencies, risks, competing priorities, and technical escalations.
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to maintain clear documentation, coordinate across teams, and drive issues through resolution.
Experience developing and improving workflows, playbooks, technical guidance, training materials, and knowledge resources that enable consistent execution.
Proficiency with CRM, project-management, and workflow tools such as Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar platforms, as well as Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and feedback to identify trends, surface risks, and improve operational performance.
Experience in public safety, SaaS, video technology, physical security technology, connected hardware, or a comparable technical environment is preferred.
Must pass a Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) background check and maintain CJIS clearance.

jobs.description:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.

This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.

Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.

About The Role

The DC Delivery E2E TPM is the single-threaded owner for delivering data center capacity from forecast → site strategy → design → construction → infrastructure readiness → go-live.

You will operate as the SSOT (Single Source of Truth) for delivery milestones, risks, and capacity outcomes while orchestrating cross-functional execution across internal teams and external partners. This is a frontier-scale role where ambiguity is high, timelines are compressed, and stakes are critical to company growth.

Responsibilities

End-to-End Capacity Delivery

Own delivery of AI-optimized data center capacity (colo, build-to-suit, retrofits, and owned facilities) from pre-contract planning through operational readiness.
Deliver MW-scale infrastructure aligned to aggressive GPU/AI system deployment targets.
Drive clarity from ambiguity—translate high-level demand signals into executable delivery programs.

Program Structuring & Execution

Decompose complex build programs into workstreams with clear owners, milestones, and deliverables.
Build integrated plans spanning real estate, power/energy, design, procurement, construction, and deployment.
Establish critical path visibility and aggressively manage schedule compression.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Orchestrate execution across:
Real estate & site selection
Power & energy strategy (utilities, PPAs, interconnects)
Data center design (MEP, liquid cooling, high-density racks)
Supply chain & long-lead equipment procurement
Construction & commissioning
Infrastructure deployment (rack/cluster install)
Networking & backbone connectivity
Security, compliance, and operations readiness

Act as the primary interface with colocation providers, EPCs, utilities, and key vendors.

Risk, Cost & Governance

Identify and drive resolution of critical risks, constraints, and blockers across power, equipment, permitting, and supply chain.
Own and maintain program budgets, CapEx forecasts, and capital allocation narratives.
Provide structured updates and escalation paths to executive leadership.

Demand & Capacity Planning Integration

Partner with capacity planning, AI infrastructure, and finance teams to translate model demand into site-level capacity strategies.
Align build plans with power availability, network topology, and hardware rollout schedules.
Continuously optimize for time-to-capacity and cost-per-MW / cost-per-GPU deployed.

Operational Excellence

Drive E2E improvements in delivery through:
Standardization of build and commissioning processes
Implementation of program tooling and dashboards
Post-mortems and lessons learned loops

Establish scalable mechanisms to support rapid global expansion.

Communication & Leadership

Serve as SSOT for program health, milestones, and risks.
Deliver concise, high-signal updates to senior executives.
Operate effectively across distributed teams with up to 50% travel.

Skills & Qualifications

12-15+ years in mission-critical facilities or data center operations
Experience managing multi-site, vendor-heavy environments
Strong expertise in electrical and mechanical systems
Proven track record in improving uptime and performance

Preferred Qualifications

Experience at hyperscalers (Google, Meta, Microsoft) or neo-cloud / AI infra companies (CoreWeave, Lambda, etc.).
Familiarity with high-density AI workloads (liquid cooling, >30kW racks, GPU clusters).
Experience with:
Utility engagement and power delivery constraints
Long-lead supply chain planning (transformers, switchgear, chillers)
Commissioning and data center handover processes

Ability to operate in high-growth, ambiguous environments with limited structure.
Strong executive presence and ability to influence without authority.

What Sets You Apart

Extreme ownership mindset — you treat capacity delivery as a personal SLA.
Ability to move fast without breaking systems, balancing urgency with rigor.
Comfort operating at the intersection of hardware, real estate, and software scaling demands.
Clear, structured communicator who can turn chaos into executable plans.
Bias for action with a track record of delivering results under pressure.

Location:
US (preferred SF Bay Area / remote with travel)

About

People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras:

Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Join the HJF Team!

HJF is seeking a Program Manager II
to oversee a collection of related/integrated projects that together support a long-term research initiative. This position strategically guides one or more project managers and related technical staff to ensure they are all working effectively toward the program’s stated objectives. Typically oversees moderately complex scope of work.

This position will be in support of the USU Military Women’s Health Research Program (MWHRP). MWHRP's purpose is to promote, manage, and coordinate research that will improve the health of military women through interdisciplinary collaboration and policy recommendations.

The Henry M. Jackson Foundation for the Advancement of Military Medicine (HJF) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing military medicine. We serve military, medical, academic and government clients by administering, managing and supporting preeminent scientific programs that benefit members of the armed forces and civilians alike. Since its founding in 1983, HJF has served as a vital link between the military medical community and its federal and private partners. HJF's support and administrative capabilities allow military medical researchers and clinicians to maintain their scientific focus and accomplish their research goals.

Responsibilities

Serve as main point of contact and liaison between internal and external stakeholders (i.e. Principal Investigators, Program Sponsors, organizational leadership and project management teams). Establish and maintain effective working relationships on matters of mutual interest. Track and report on progress and outcomes.
Serve as point of contact and liaison between internal and external stakeholders (i.e. Principal Investigators, Program Sponsors, organizational leadership and project management teams). Establish and maintain effective working relationships on matters of mutual interest. Track and report on progress and outcomes.
Develop, lead and organize programs aimed at addressing the needs of military women and/or investigate the population’s needs and current healthcare gaps. This may include conducting outreach for focus group participation and coordinating focus group activities.
Liaison with community partners to help increase awareness of the program’s presence, capabilities and sharing of its mission. May lead to the engagement of a program/community advisory board, conference and/or stakeholder engagement meetings.
Provide on-site conference/meeting support including registration of attendees and direct coordination with the facility/venue staff.
Cultivate relationships with external community leaders to facilitate sharing information and resources.
Supervise, advise and guide Project Managers and technical staff throughout the program lifecycle, focusing on the strategic direction of the projects. Take corrective action as needed.
Manage key program elements, including but not limited to goals and milestones, risks, available resources, budgets, standard operating procedures, quality control, and results. Identify project interdependencies, aligning resources and efforts where appropriate.
Lead data collection, analysis, and quality assurance for the MWHRP database by consolidating project, publication, and presentation metrics across cross-functional sources, partnering with the Principal Investigator (PI) for review, and refining database structures to ensure accurate tracking and strict data consistency.
Support and participate in planning, creation and submission of proposals and agreements as requested.
Provide support to overall research activities that are part of a larger program. May mentor and lead less-experienced team members.
May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned or directed by the supervisor. This may include attendance of and participation in required training and events/activities for role.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Direct Supervisor: Direct authority to make decisions on the following: employee hiring, disciplinary action, starting salaries and merit increases; conduct employee performance evaluations and directs work activities.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree required. Business Administration or Life Sciences field of study preferred.
Minimum of 6-8 years experience required.

Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Familiarity with knowledge of federal budget processes and fundamental principles of project management.
Familiarity with the military healthcare environment, military populations, and military culture preferred.

jobs.description:
Description

Our Program Manager's are always thinking about the bigger picture. Every position at Amazon offers the opportunity for employees to influence business decisions and shape the future. But as a Senior Program Manager, pioneering new ways of thinking, designing and delivering is your mission. Collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, you’ll continuously be scoping out new solutions. You’ll conduct your own research and analysis, always with an eye on the long-term vision of the business. This is your opportunity to have a big impact on some of the most exciting new ideas that are shaping the future of Amazon.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract position.

Key job responsibilities

Create innovative solutions using data and research to address wider challenges in your organization
Take a big-picture approach in your analysis of business operations, driving improvements across a range of teams and organizations
Work alongside senior leadership to establish and prioritize improvement programs, seeing them through from start to finish
Enhance operational performance on every program in partnership with your stakeholders

A day in the life

As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll drive and manage the implementation of creative, data-driven change in Amazon, leading improvement projects and programs. You’ll use strategic thinking to define and implement an efficient project plan. Some managers are based on-site while others work remotely, depending on the most suitable option for their team and tasks.

Senior Program Managers have significant responsibilities, and you’ll deal with complex challenges with creativity, innovation, and leadership. With a responsibility extending beyond process improvements, you could also contribute to improving other areas of the business, like diversity, equity, and inclusion.

About The Team

When you click on your screen, and know that your Amazon parcel will arrive with you on the next day, you’ve just use one of the world’s most sophisticated fulfillment networks. At AMZL Europe, we deliver millions of packages daily to customers at record speed and quality. The work that Launch and Expansion do is at the heart of that. Our relentless ambition is to make AMZL Europe more and more cost-effective and customer centric. We’re doing that by improving our existing network, inventing new and creative ways of making last-mile delivery more efficient, and optimizing the development of our Under the Roof and On Road Infrastructure. Within the team we have a variety of roles. Typical examples include program managers responsible for selecting and launching new sites, planners working out how we solve challenges such as low emission zones and EV charging, strategy teams looking at how we get the most out of our existing buildings, and analysts using data to deliver insights into how we work and how we should be working.

Help plan the future of the biggest last mile delivery network in Europe

Select, build and launch huge buildings and infrastructure with multi-million dollar budgets

Make decisions that shape Amazon’s fulfillment strategy across the globe

Work at the forefront of logistics innovation

Bachelor's degree
Experience in program or project management
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

project management certification such as PMP, Scrum, or other Agile certification

jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

We are HALO! We connect people and brands to create unforgettable, meaningful, and lasting experiences that build brand engagement and loyalty for our over 60,000 clients globally. Our nearly 2,000 employees and 1,000 Account Executives located in 40+ sales offices across the United States are the reason HALO is the global leader in branded merchandise, uniform programs, and recognition and incentive solutions.

HALO is seeking an External Workforce & BPO Program Manager
to lead and evolve our contingent workforce and outsourced services programs. This role serves as the primary owner of the processes, partnerships, and operational controls that support our global non-employee workforce, including domestic and global temporary labor, as well as agency and BPO partners.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing workforce strategies and executive-level partnerships as they are maintaining accurate records, tracking headcount, generating reports and insights, auditing data, and ensuring operational excellence. This role requires a hands-on, detail-oriented professional who thrives in building structure, creating scalable processes, managing vendor relationships, and driving business outcomes across a complex global workforce environment.

Duties & Responsibilities

Stakeholder Consultation & Workforce Planning

Serve as a trusted advisor to Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, Finance, and business leaders regarding contingent labor and outsourced workforce strategies.
Consult with business stakeholders on talent fulfillment options, including employee, contingent labor, project-based resources, and BPO solutions.
Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders on the optimal talent fulfillment approach, working to understand workforce needs and develop scalable, cost-effective staffing solutions.
Build strong working relationships across functions to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective decision-making.
Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to support workforce planning, budget forecasting, labor cost analysis, and spend reporting associated with contingent workforce and outsourced labor programs.

Program Creation & System Administration

Own the day-to-day administration of contingent workforce records, tracking systems, vendor rosters, contracts, and reporting tools to ensure accuracy and visibility across the organization.
Maintain a high degree of data integrity through regular audits, reconciliations, reporting reviews, and process documentation.
Establish and continuously improve processes that create structure, accountability, and scalability as the program evolves.
Reconcile and process invoices associated with agencies, ensuring accuracy against approved contracts, rates, and SOWs
Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies, payment issues, and vendor inquiries.

Contingent Workforce Program Governance

Lead cross-functional collaboration with business leaders, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, Finance, and Legal to assess workforce solution providers, staffing partners, and contingent labor vendors.
Direct operational lifecycle workflows of domestic and global contract talent, ensuring successful implementation through established governance, contracting, risk management, onboarding and offboarding processes.
Partner with HRBPs and TA to create guidelines for how and when hiring needs are released to secondary or tertiary staffing agencies.
Ensure QBRs are conducted to assess optimization, program savings, SLA, and other agreed-upon metrics.
Track contract renewals, fee structures, volume discount tiers built into various agreements.

BPO Relationship & Vendor Management

Develop trusted, collaborative relationships with external partners locally and globally while holding vendors accountable for performance, service delivery, compliance, and business outcomes.
Influence vendor behavior through partnership, performance management, and continuous improvement initiatives rather than solely through contractual enforcement.
Serve as the primary point of contact to investigate and resolve third-party delivery bottlenecks, performance lags, or cross-border vendor staffing issues.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree preferred.
6+ years of experience in contingent workforce management, workforce programs, talent acquisition operations, vendor management, HR operations, procurement, program management, or a related discipline.
Demonstrated experience managing programs that require both strategic stakeholder consultation and detailed operational execution.
Proven ability to establish, document, and continuously improve processes while maintaining data integrity, operational controls, and program consistency in evolving environments.
Experience evaluating workforce fulfillment models and advising stakeholders on employee, contingent labor, project-based, and outsourced workforce solutions.
Strong relationship management and influencing skills with the ability to effectively partner with business leaders, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, Finance, Legal, vendors, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Prior success migrating a corporate entity from manual spreadsheet-based vendor tracking to a formal Vendor Management System (VMS) strongly preferred.
Certification in Contingent Workforce Management (CCWP) or project management principles (PMP) strongly preferred.

Compensation:
The estimated base salary range for this position is between $95,000 and $110,000 annually. Please note that this pay range serves as a general guideline and reflects a broad spectrum of labor markets across the US. While it is uncommon for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the range, compensation decisions are influenced by various factors. At HALO, these include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's work experience, location, education and training, key skills, internal equity, external market data, and broader market and business considerations.

Benefits:
At HALO, we offer benefits that support all aspects of your life, helping you find a work-life balance that’s right for you. Our comprehensive benefits include nationwide coverage for Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability insurance, along with additional Voluntary Benefits. Prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan, Health Savings Accounts (HSA), and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA).

Application Information:
To apply to this opportunity, click the APPLY button at the top right or very bottom of the screen to complete our online application. A resume is optional, so you may choose to upload and have the application prefill with your information. There are 5 sections to complete in total, including General information, Work History, Education, Compliance, and optional demographic questions. Once you have successfully submitted your application, you will receive a submission confirmation email from our system.

Application Deadline:
Applications are reviewed and processed only when there is a specific need or opportunity, rather than on a fixed schedule or at a set deadline. Because they are reviewed on an as-needed basis, a job posting will be removed once the position has been filled or is no longer available.

Career Advancement: At HALO, we love promoting from within. Internal promotions have been the key to our exponential growth in the last few years. With so many industry leaders at HALO, you'll have the opportunity to accelerate your career by learning from their experience, insights, and skills and gain access to HALO's influential global network, leadership experiences, and diverse thinking.

We keep our promise for excellence with an unrelenting commitment to achieving results and supporting one another to stay accountable, transparent, and dependable.

Working closely with hardware, software, operations, and go-to-market teams, you will map out the optimal route for new product introductions: establishing the plan, driving alignment, surfacing tradeoffs, managing dependencies, and holding the organization accountable to scope, schedule, technical readiness, and launch quality. If you excel at transforming potential roadblocks into smooth, predictable execution without losing speed, this is your green light to lead.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Hardware, you will operate as the technical program integrator across Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Quality, and other key partners. On many programs, you will work alongside a second Technical Program Manager (TPgM) focused on detailed hardware execution. In that model, you would own the integrated product plan and cross-functional delivery system, while partnering closely with the hardware TPgM to keep hardware execution, software delivery, system integration, operational readiness, and go-to-market planning aligned. The Sr. Technical Program Manager does not replace functional technical leaders, but must understand the system deeply enough to connect decisions across disciplines, expose hidden dependencies early, and drive the right conversations at the right time.

Direct Flagship Delivery: Lead 1–3 concurrent complex product programs across hardware, firmware, cloud software, and operations to turn strategic vision into fully validated, commercially ready products.
Build Integrated Master Plans: Connect architecture, validation, release, and launch milestones into a single clear execution roadmap to maintain absolute visibility over critical paths and key dependencies.
Unify Cross-Functional Teams: Serve as the connective tissue between Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Go-To-Market teams to keep all domain execution plans aligned.
Drive Risk & Tradeoff Mitigation: Identify system-level interdependencies and navigate tradeoffs between scope, cost, and schedule to resolve bottlenecks before they disrupt launch timelines.
Enforce Launch & Phase Readiness: Establish evidence-based entry/exit criteria for pilot builds and commercial releases to ensure flawless quality upon market release.
Optimize Program Governance: Elevate program management tools, decision logs, and cadence frameworks to increase predictability and accountability across the entire organization.

Ideal Profile

Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience leading complex, end-to-end product programs spanning hardware, firmware, software, and operational launch.
Systems Thinking & Technical Depth: Strong ability to evaluate how hardware, firmware, cloud, and operational decisions interact across the entire product ecosystem.
Integrated Product Delivery: Deep knowledge of hardware/software lifecycles, cross-domain integration, system validation, and commercial launch readiness.
Program Governance: Expertise in building and driving integrated master schedules, dependency maps, risk mitigation strategies, and executive-level reporting.
Technical Credibility: Skilled at engaging with technical leads, constructively challenging incomplete plans, and surfacing hidden risks or assumptions early.
Cross-Domain Collaboration: Experience partnering with engineering, product, operations, and quality teams to align roadmaps and shared deliverables.
Go-To-Market Execution: Demonstrated ability to coordinate technical, operational, and commercial workstreams through launch and initial customer adoption.
Leadership & Ambiguity: Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving clarity, consensus, and accountability in dynamic environments.

Additional Assets

Experience delivering connected devices or other products where hardware, firmware, cloud, and application releases must come together for a successful launch.
New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing ramp, regulatory compliance, and post-launch operational handoffs.
Background in a related industry such as transportation technology, IoT, edge systems, intelligent infrastructure, or similarly complex product environments.

Drive End-to-End Visibility: Create high-integrity tracking for program scope, dependencies, and risk—enabling proactive decision-making and eliminating late-stage surprises.

Raise the Bar for Delivery: Implement scalable planning frameworks, review mechanisms, and accountability structures that make future product launches faster and more predictable.

meoSphere is SES’s next-generation Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) satellite constellation, designed to deliver secure connectivity services to government agencies, enterprises, and commercial customers. It will also provide high-speed broadband internet to eliminate global connectivity dead zones.

To accelerate development timelines, reduce costs, and ensure quality, SES is internalizing a critical segment of the satellite supply chain: the final integration of partner satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads, all within a cutting-edge manufacturing and test facility.

The Agile Technical Program Manager (ATPM) is responsible for leading the execution, planning, integration, agile delivery and overall programmatic performance of a major team/segment as part of the greater meoSphere Integrated Product Team (IPT).

Reporting to the VP Programme Management and matrixed into the relevant segment team, the ATPM forms a delivery leadership partnership with the segment Technical Lead, combining technical understanding with agile execution, conventional program controls, cross-segment integration and IPT leadership to ensure successful delivery of program objectives.

The ATPM is a key driver of SES's transformation towards a highly agile, collaborative and integrated way of working, enabling rapid learning cycles, continuous integration and delivery across the meoSphere programme.

Programme & Delivery Leadership

Lead planning, execution, and delivery of the assigned segment/team.
Partner with the Technical Lead to establish priorities, objectives, and delivery plans.

Agile Execution

Support implementation of SAFe-inspired agile practices across the programme.
Facilitate Program Increment (PI) planning, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives for the assigned segment/team.
Drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement through agile delivery practices.
Monitor delivery performance against PI objectives, identify blockers, and drive resolution to maintain delivery commitments.

Engage with engineering, operations, procurement, finance, suppliers and leadership stakeholders.
Provide timely and accurate status, risk, dependency, and decision information to support effective programme execution.

Programme & Delivery Leadership. Drives execution, delivery outcomes and team accountability in a complex Agile environment.
Agile Delivery. Applies Agile practices to plan, prioritize and deliver work iteratively while adapting to changing programme needs.
Stakeholder Management & Influence. Builds alignment across technical and business stakeholders, communicating effectively and influencing without direct authority.
Cross-Functional Collaboration. Partners effectively across teams, functions and external partners to achieve shared programme objectives.

Risk & Issue Management. Proactively identifoes, manages and resolves risks, issues and delivery dependencies.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or another relevant technical discipline.
Typically 8+ years of relevant experience leading complex technical programmes, projects or engineering developments.
Experience delivering major subsystems, workstreams or integrated teams within a complex technical environment.
Strong programme and project management experience covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, resource and change management.
Strong understanding of systems engineering, integration and verification activities.
Practical experience working in Agile environments and applying Agile delivery practices.
Experience within the satellite, space, aerospace, telecommunications or similarly complex systems industries.

Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Technical Project Manager (Compliance & Certifications) to coordinate, manage, and drive our technical compliance, security, and industry certification initiatives. In this role, you will be the operational engine behind our compliance roadmap—managing the rigid timelines of external audits while aligning execution across internal software development, IT/TechOps, and business operations cycles.

As a key member of our execution team, you will ensure that all compliance projects are structured, tracked, and reported in strict accordance with our corporate PMO Standards.

You will directly own and manage the planning, tracking, and execution of our annual Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation and SOC2 (Type 1 and Type 2) audits. This role provides the critical project management, compliance oversight, governance, and auditability necessary to keep all teams aligned and audit-ready.

Key Responsibilities

PMO Reporting & Project Standards
PMO Standards Alignment: Manage and structure all compliance, security, and certification project plans, trackers, and document repositories in accordance with established PMO methodologies and guidelines.
Standardized Status Reporting: Provide routine, structured progress reports, KPI dashboards, and project health updates (covering milestones, risks, and blockers) as defined by PMO reporting frameworks.
Risk & Issue Escalation: Actively track dependencies and risks, executing formal escalation paths per PMO standards when compliance milestones are in jeopardy.
Platform Management: Maintain up-to-date program trackers, schedules, and resource planning artifacts within central PMO tools (such as Asana or Jira) to ensure a single source of truth.
Hybrid Project Management & Governance
Milestone & Critical Path Tracking: Establish clear, phase-gate project plans for upcoming audits, mapping out the critical path for audit readiness, dry-runs, evidence lock-down, and formal evaluation windows.
Requirements Translation: Translate complex, rigid compliance controls (e.g., security protocols, data-filtering standards) into clear, actionable technical specifications, user stories, and development tasks.
Engineering Alignment: Partner with Security, TechOps, Data, and Engineering teams to slot compliance-related tasks and vulnerability remediations into active development cycles (sprints or Kanban) without disrupting the core product roadmap.
Cross-Functional Compliance Oversight: Oversee key operational controls managed by technical partner teams to ensure continuous audit readiness.
Audit Coordination & Evidence Gathering
Audit Liaison: Serve as the primary operational contact and liaison for external auditors and assessors (e.g., MRC, EY, SOC2 auditors), ensuring meetings, requests, and inquiries are managed efficiently.
Evidence Management: Project manage the continuous gathering, formatting, and submission of technical evidence (configurations, access logs, architectural diagrams) required for SOC2 and MRC evaluations.
Remediation Tracking: Monitor and drive the resolution of any compliance gaps, audit findings, or vulnerability remediation tasks identified during pre-audits or continuous monitoring.
Media Rating Council (MRC) Certification Support
Audit Lifecycle Management: Project manage the end-to-end timeline for annual MRC audits, pre-assessment phases, and ongoing compliance reviews.
Adtech & Measurement Standards: Coordinate engineering and product tasks related to data pipelines, measurement methodologies, and filtration logic to ensure strict alignment with MRC and industry measurement standards.
Disclosure & Change Governance: Coordinate the preparation, maintenance, and regular updating of methodology disclosures, and establish a "Journal of Change" process to manage and communicate changes to accredited elements with MRC and auditor representatives.
Business Operations Alignment: Project manage compliance workflows across business operations required by MRC standards, including Business Partner Qualification (BPQ/client vetting), client onboarding/support disclosures, and discrepancy/data reissuance tracking.
SOC2 Type 1 & Type 2 Support
Audit Execution: Organize the schedule, operational execution, and readiness milestones for annual SOC2 Type 1 and Type 2 audits.
Controls Integration: Partner with engineering and IT teams to ensure system monitoring, access control reviews, and infrastructure configurations are consistently maintained and documented according to SOC2 Trust Services Criteria.
Automation Management: Help manage and monitor compliance automation tooling (e.g., Vanta, Drata) to ensure continuous control verification and evidence tracking.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience: 5 years of experience as a Technical Project Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Manager in a SaaS, Adtech, or software engineering environment.
PMO Alignment: Proven experience managing projects and reporting project health, timelines, and status updates in alignment with structured PMO frameworks.
Hybrid PM Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage fixed-deadline, structured compliance timelines (milestone/waterfall approach) while integrating execution into Agile-operating engineering teams.
Compliance & Governance: Practical experience managing projects, timelines, evidence gathering, or compliance oversight related to SOC2 audits or Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation.
Project Tracking Platforms: Advanced proficiency in structured project planning and execution tracking within platforms like Asana or Jira.
Technical Literacy: Comfort working alongside engineering and IT teams; ability to understand cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS/GCP), database schemas, and identity/access management frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

Adtech Background: Deep understanding of ad-serving technology, measurement methodologies, and industry measurement standards.
Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional), CAPM, PMI-ACP, or introductory security/compliance credentials.
Compliance Tooling: Experience using compliance automation platforms (e.g., Drata, Vanta, Secureframe) to track control verification and evidence gathering.

Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
Regular company events and activities
Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
401k Plan – 4% employee match
Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading cloud provider of virtualized infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and many other services all over the world. Our customers trust us to handle their data with air-tight security measures, which is something that we guarantee.

The AWS Data Center Security team is looking for a creative, innovative, results-oriented program manager in Georgia/Atlanta area to lead security and security-systems projects and programs in the data center environment. The ideal candidate will be able to contribute to a collaborative and productive environment with a strong service-oriented culture among multiple diverse and highly skilled teams of project and program managers. These teams are responsible for the design, installation, and evolution of physical security systems and programs to include intrusion detection, access control/management, CCTV, screening, emergency response, etc.

A successful candidate will have the ability to manage difficult and interdependent projects with a regional impact. You will be responsible for enabling the interpretation of Threat Assessments and AWS Physical Security Standards to assure the proper security mitigations are selected and implemented to meet the unique challenges in each area. You will be responsible for collaborating cross-functionally to assure each data center meets the high standards AWS sets for physical security. You must also ensure local security teams have the technical knowledge and resources necessary to meet the ongoing physical security mission.

Key job responsibilities

Project Management for physical security systems related to new construction, expansion, and retrofit projects.
Preparation of physical security project lifecycle management including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budget, change orders, and close-out documentation.
Contemporary knowledge of emerging physical security technologies to assess their applicability within the AWS physical security program.
Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) support for leadership to make strategic decisions regarding technology and procedure.
Balance performance metrics such as physical security system installation vendor service delivery performance, actual spend vs. budget variance, cost reduction goal attainment, post installation defect rates, physical security program analysis, etc.
Manage vendors for the on-boarding, RFQ, bid, contract, QA/QC, and support processes.
Effectively and accurately manage multi-million dollar budgets for infrastructure projects and initiatives.
Collaborate across teams and provide support for global initiatives.

About The Team

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

This position is for an Operational Security Manager in the Solutions Services Group (SSG). This is an exciting role that will give you the opportunity to work with Lenovo Engineering teams around the world to help Lenovo Business Units align with various regional, national and international security standards and regulations. You will be working alongside some of the best security teams in the industry. You will join a growing team of security professionals to protect and maintain the effectiveness of managed service capabilities.

The Operational Security Manager supports cybersecurity incident response, investigation, escalation, and regulatory reporting, with a focus on the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Working across Cybersecurity, Product Security, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and Engineering, this role ensures incidents are properly assessed, documented, and reported within required timelines. The Operational Security Manager also provides technical leadership and continuously improves security processes, controls, and supporting technologies.

What You'll Be Doing

Support the full cybersecurity incident response lifecycle, including triage, investigation, containment, escalation, remediation, recovery, and post-incident review across enterprise and product environments.
Coordinate incident response activities across Cybersecurity, Product Security, Engineering, IT, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and external partners, including support for critical incidents outside normal business hours when necessary.
Assess incidents and actively exploited vulnerabilities affecting products marketed or sold in the EU to determine applicable handling and notification requirements, particularly under the EU Cyber Resilience Act.
Coordinate timely and accurate regulatory notifications, ensuring required incident, product, impact, mitigation, and remediation information is gathered, validated, documented, and communicated.
Maintain incident records, regulatory assessments, reporting decisions, evidence, and chain of custody in support of internal, legal, audit, and regulatory requirements.
Strengthen incident response readiness through playbooks, tabletop exercises, lessons learned, metrics, automation, and improvements to monitoring and investigation capabilities.

What You’ll Need

Significant experience leading cybersecurity incident response or security operations, with demonstrated knowledge of the full incident response lifecycle.
Experience investigating incidents across product, application, cloud, infrastructure, network, endpoint, and third-party environments.
Working knowledge of EU cybersecurity regulatory requirements, particularly the incident and actively exploited vulnerability notification requirements of the EU Cyber Resilience Act.
Strong understanding of threat and vulnerability analysis, digital forensics, evidence preservation, chain of custody, and technologies such as SIEM, endpoint security, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management platforms.
Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear incident assessments, escalation decisions, executive communications, and regulatory notifications.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage high-pressure incidents and meet operational and regulatory deadlines.

An international team with a high focus on Gender Diversity.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Technical Project Manager (Compliance & Certifications) to coordinate, manage, and drive our technical compliance, security, and industry certification initiatives. In this role, you will be the operational engine behind our compliance roadmap—managing the rigid timelines of external audits while aligning execution across internal software development, IT/TechOps, and business operations cycles.

As a key member of our execution team, you will ensure that all compliance projects are structured, tracked, and reported in strict accordance with our corporate PMO Standards.

You will directly own and manage the planning, tracking, and execution of our annual Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation and SOC2 (Type 1 and Type 2) audits. This role provides the critical project management, compliance oversight, governance, and auditability necessary to keep all teams aligned and audit-ready.

Key Responsibilities

PMO Reporting & Project Standards
PMO Standards Alignment: Manage and structure all compliance, security, and certification project plans, trackers, and document repositories in accordance with established PMO methodologies and guidelines.
Standardized Status Reporting: Provide routine, structured progress reports, KPI dashboards, and project health updates (covering milestones, risks, and blockers) as defined by PMO reporting frameworks.
Risk & Issue Escalation: Actively track dependencies and risks, executing formal escalation paths per PMO standards when compliance milestones are in jeopardy.
Platform Management: Maintain up-to-date program trackers, schedules, and resource planning artifacts within central PMO tools (such as Asana or Jira) to ensure a single source of truth.
Hybrid Project Management & Governance
Milestone & Critical Path Tracking: Establish clear, phase-gate project plans for upcoming audits, mapping out the critical path for audit readiness, dry-runs, evidence lock-down, and formal evaluation windows.
Requirements Translation: Translate complex, rigid compliance controls (e.g., security protocols, data-filtering standards) into clear, actionable technical specifications, user stories, and development tasks.
Engineering Alignment: Partner with Security, TechOps, Data, and Engineering teams to slot compliance-related tasks and vulnerability remediations into active development cycles (sprints or Kanban) without disrupting the core product roadmap.
Cross-Functional Compliance Oversight: Oversee key operational controls managed by technical partner teams to ensure continuous audit readiness.
Audit Coordination & Evidence Gathering
Audit Liaison: Serve as the primary operational contact and liaison for external auditors and assessors (e.g., MRC, EY, SOC2 auditors), ensuring meetings, requests, and inquiries are managed efficiently.
Evidence Management: Project manage the continuous gathering, formatting, and submission of technical evidence (configurations, access logs, architectural diagrams) required for SOC2 and MRC evaluations.
Remediation Tracking: Monitor and drive the resolution of any compliance gaps, audit findings, or vulnerability remediation tasks identified during pre-audits or continuous monitoring.
Media Rating Council (MRC) Certification Support
Audit Lifecycle Management: Project manage the end-to-end timeline for annual MRC audits, pre-assessment phases, and ongoing compliance reviews.
Adtech & Measurement Standards: Coordinate engineering and product tasks related to data pipelines, measurement methodologies, and filtration logic to ensure strict alignment with MRC and industry measurement standards.
Disclosure & Change Governance: Coordinate the preparation, maintenance, and regular updating of methodology disclosures, and establish a "Journal of Change" process to manage and communicate changes to accredited elements with MRC and auditor representatives.
Business Operations Alignment: Project manage compliance workflows across business operations required by MRC standards, including Business Partner Qualification (BPQ/client vetting), client onboarding/support disclosures, and discrepancy/data reissuance tracking.
SOC2 Type 1 & Type 2 Support
Audit Execution: Organize the schedule, operational execution, and readiness milestones for annual SOC2 Type 1 and Type 2 audits.
Controls Integration: Partner with engineering and IT teams to ensure system monitoring, access control reviews, and infrastructure configurations are consistently maintained and documented according to SOC2 Trust Services Criteria.
Automation Management: Help manage and monitor compliance automation tooling (e.g., Vanta, Drata) to ensure continuous control verification and evidence tracking.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience: 5 years of experience as a Technical Project Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Manager in a SaaS, Adtech, or software engineering environment.
PMO Alignment: Proven experience managing projects and reporting project health, timelines, and status updates in alignment with structured PMO frameworks.
Hybrid PM Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage fixed-deadline, structured compliance timelines (milestone/waterfall approach) while integrating execution into Agile-operating engineering teams.
Compliance & Governance: Practical experience managing projects, timelines, evidence gathering, or compliance oversight related to SOC2 audits or Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation.
Project Tracking Platforms: Advanced proficiency in structured project planning and execution tracking within platforms like Asana or Jira.
Technical Literacy: Comfort working alongside engineering and IT teams; ability to understand cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS/GCP), database schemas, and identity/access management frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

Adtech Background: Deep understanding of ad-serving technology, measurement methodologies, and industry measurement standards.
Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional), CAPM, PMI-ACP, or introductory security/compliance credentials.
Compliance Tooling: Experience using compliance automation platforms (e.g., Drata, Vanta, Secureframe) to track control verification and evidence gathering.

US Benefits & Perks

Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
Regular company events and activities
Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
401k Plan – 4% employee match
Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.
