The Program Manager is responsible for leading the integrated delivery of complex programmes comprising multiple projects, workstreams and stakeholder groups.

The initial assignment will support a major strategic programme involving artificial intelligence, automation and emerging technologies. The role will establish the programme structure, roadmap, integrated plan and governance arrangements and provide clear oversight of outcomes, dependencies, risks, resources, costs and decisions.

This is a generalist Program Manager position. The successful candidate may subsequently lead other strategic, regulatory, product, data, digital and operational-change programmes as business priorities evolve.

Key Responsibilities

Establish the programme structure, governance model and delivery cadence.
Translate strategic objectives into an integrated programme roadmap and plan.
Define:
programme outcomes and scope;
projects and workstreams;
milestones and delivery gates;
roles and accountabilities;
governance and decision forums;
escalation routes.

Coordinate business, product, technology, operations, risk and other stakeholders.
Manage programme-level:
scope and milestones;
dependencies and critical paths;
resources and capacity;
costs and forecasts;
risks, assumptions, issues and decisions;
actions and governance requirements.

Coordinate opportunity assessment, prioritisation and mobilisation.
Integrate requirements, solution delivery, controls, testing and operational readiness into the programme plan.
Coordinate pilot design, implementation, adoption and value-measurement activities.
Monitor progress against agreed outcomes, milestones and delivery gates.
Identify and resolve cross-project conflicts, dependencies and delivery constraints.
Escalate material risks, resource gaps and unresolved decisions.
Prepare executive updates, governance materials and decision papers.
Facilitate programme, steering and decision-making forums.
Manage scope changes and assess their impact on outcomes, schedule, cost, resources and risk.
Maintain clear records of programme decisions, approvals, actions and delivery evidence.
Coordinate implementation, hand-offs and transition into sustainable ownership.
Support benefit tracking, post-implementation reviews and lessons learned.
Use approved digital and AI-enabled tools to improve programme planning, analysis and reporting while retaining appropriate human accountability.

Scope and Accountability

Leads a complex programme comprising multiple projects or interconnected workstreams.
Defines and maintains the programme-management approach, integrated plan and governance structure.
Operates with a high degree of autonomy within agreed strategic objectives.
Coordinates stakeholders across business, product, technology, operations and control functions.
Accountable for consolidated programme visibility, including outcomes, progress, dependencies, risks, resources and decisions.
Develops options and recommendations where material delivery trade-offs exist.
Ensures programme-level risks, dependencies and decisions are identified, owned and escalated appropriately.
Coordinates project and workstream leads without necessarily holding formal line-management responsibility.
Supports sponsors and governance forums in making timely, evidence-based decisions.
Does not ordinarily own the underlying business, product or technology functions.
Has no formal people-management responsibility unless separately assigned.

Skills And Experience

Strong programme-management experience across complex, cross-functional initiatives.
Experience leading programmes comprising multiple projects, workstreams or delivery teams.
Strong integrated-planning, governance and dependency-management capability.
Experience managing programme risks, resources, costs, forecasts and executive reporting.
Ability to translate strategic objectives into executable roadmaps and delivery plans.
Ability to identify critical dependencies, constraints and cross-project impacts.
Strong senior-stakeholder management, facilitation and influencing skills.
Ability to develop and present evidence-based options and recommendations.
Experience supporting governance forums and executive decision-making.
Working understanding of requirements, testing, controls, implementation and operational readiness.
Knowledge of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery methods.
Experience in financial services or another regulated industry is desirable.
Exposure to artificial intelligence, automation, data, digital or emerging-technology programmes is desirable.
Specialist technical AI expertise is not required.

Qualifications

Relevant degree or equivalent professional experience.
Programme or project-management qualification, such as PMP, MSP, PRINCE2 or an Agile delivery certification, is advantageous.
Experience using programme-planning, reporting and delivery-management tools is advantageous.
Preferred qualification - Demonstrated experience establishing and scaling enterprise AI programs, including governance, operating model development, business activation, platform adoption, risk management, and measurable value realization across multiple business units."

$114,700 - 194,900 USD

This role provides the critical project management, compliance oversight, governance, and auditability necessary to keep all teams aligned and audit-ready.

Key Responsibilities

PMO Reporting & Project Standards
PMO Standards Alignment: Manage and structure all compliance, security, and certification project plans, trackers, and document repositories in accordance with established PMO methodologies and guidelines.
Standardized Status Reporting: Provide routine, structured progress reports, KPI dashboards, and project health updates (covering milestones, risks, and blockers) as defined by PMO reporting frameworks.
Risk & Issue Escalation: Actively track dependencies and risks, executing formal escalation paths per PMO standards when compliance milestones are in jeopardy.
Platform Management: Maintain up-to-date program trackers, schedules, and resource planning artifacts within central PMO tools (such as Asana or Jira) to ensure a single source of truth.
Hybrid Project Management & Governance
Milestone & Critical Path Tracking: Establish clear, phase-gate project plans for upcoming audits, mapping out the critical path for audit readiness, dry-runs, evidence lock-down, and formal evaluation windows.
Requirements Translation: Translate complex, rigid compliance controls (e.g., security protocols, data-filtering standards) into clear, actionable technical specifications, user stories, and development tasks.
Engineering Alignment: Partner with Security, TechOps, Data, and Engineering teams to slot compliance-related tasks and vulnerability remediations into active development cycles (sprints or Kanban) without disrupting the core product roadmap.
Cross-Functional Compliance Oversight: Oversee key operational controls managed by technical partner teams to ensure continuous audit readiness.
Audit Coordination & Evidence Gathering
Audit Liaison: Serve as the primary operational contact and liaison for external auditors and assessors (e.g., MRC, EY, SOC2 auditors), ensuring meetings, requests, and inquiries are managed efficiently.
Evidence Management: Project manage the continuous gathering, formatting, and submission of technical evidence (configurations, access logs, architectural diagrams) required for SOC2 and MRC evaluations.
Remediation Tracking: Monitor and drive the resolution of any compliance gaps, audit findings, or vulnerability remediation tasks identified during pre-audits or continuous monitoring.
Media Rating Council (MRC) Certification Support
Audit Lifecycle Management: Project manage the end-to-end timeline for annual MRC audits, pre-assessment phases, and ongoing compliance reviews.
Adtech & Measurement Standards: Coordinate engineering and product tasks related to data pipelines, measurement methodologies, and filtration logic to ensure strict alignment with MRC and industry measurement standards.
Disclosure & Change Governance: Coordinate the preparation, maintenance, and regular updating of methodology disclosures, and establish a "Journal of Change" process to manage and communicate changes to accredited elements with MRC and auditor representatives.
Business Operations Alignment: Project manage compliance workflows across business operations required by MRC standards, including Business Partner Qualification (BPQ/client vetting), client onboarding/support disclosures, and discrepancy/data reissuance tracking.
SOC2 Type 1 & Type 2 Support
Audit Execution: Organize the schedule, operational execution, and readiness milestones for annual SOC2 Type 1 and Type 2 audits.
Controls Integration: Partner with engineering and IT teams to ensure system monitoring, access control reviews, and infrastructure configurations are consistently maintained and documented according to SOC2 Trust Services Criteria.
Automation Management: Help manage and monitor compliance automation tooling (e.g., Vanta, Drata) to ensure continuous control verification and evidence tracking.

Required Qualifications & Experience

PMO Alignment: Proven experience managing projects and reporting project health, timelines, and status updates in alignment with structured PMO frameworks.

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

YOUR IMPACT

Are you passionate about delivering exceptional service and solving complex challenges at the intersection of law and technology? As a Project Manager for OpenText’s LegalTech team, you will lead client engagements from kickoff to billing, ensuring seamless execution and strategic outcomes. In this high-impact role, you will work with law firms, corporate legal departments, and review partners to bring clarity, precision, and excellence to every phase of the eDiscovery lifecycle.

This is a dynamic opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, values client relationships, and enjoys collaborating across teams to make a real difference in the legal tech space.

YOU ARE GREAT AT

Lead strategic client engagements: act as the primary consultant for assigned matters, guiding projects from initial proposal through final invoicing while delivering outstanding service and value.

Deliver client-centric solutions: consult with clients to understand goals, propose effective workflows, and proactively manage challenges. Build trust through responsiveness, insight, and consistency.

Collaborate across teams: partner with internal departments, corporate legal teams, and law firms to align efforts, ensure quality, and meet case-specific objectives.

Manage end-to-end discovery tasks: oversee technical workflows including data processing, user and case setup, and production execution to support client deadlines and goals.

Contribute to team success: support unassigned or escalated projects when needed. Maintain thorough documentation of project activity, custom workflows, and client communications.

Drive innovation and efficiency: identify opportunities for process improvements and implement technical or procedural solutions that enhance service quality and delivery speed.

Maintain financial accountability: track and bill consulting time accurately. Ensure fee structures and estimates are clear at the outset and aligned throughout an engagement.

What You Need To Succeed

You are highly organized and detail oriented. You have the ability to balance multiple complex projects without losing track of deliverables, deadlines, or dependencies.

You are intellectually curious and thrive on solving complex problems with precision and creativity.

You communicate clearly, whether you are guiding a client, coaching a team member, or breaking down technical concepts.

You build trust quickly and foster strong relationships across departments and with clients.

You stay cool under pressure and adapt quickly in fast-paced, evolving environments.

You take initiative, follow through, and always aim to deliver exceptional results.

Five or more years in eDiscovery, litigation support, or legal consulting roles, with a strong understanding of the litigation lifecycle, the EDRM, and TAR/CAL workflows.

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university; JD, MBA, or advanced degree a plus.

Proven experience managing complex projects and delivering client-facing services in deadline-driven environments.

Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical concepts clearly to legal and non-technical audiences.

Familiarity with the evolving role of artificial intelligence in eDiscovery.

Ability to work cross-functionally and collaborate effectively with internal teams, external partners, and clients.

Experience with OpenText eDiscovery (formerly Axcelerate) is a strong plus.

Requirements may dictate the necessity to work hours outside of normal, 40-hour workweek.

While not frequent, some travel throughout the US may be required.

ONE LAST THING

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:
At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. A summary of those benefits can be found on our Why Join Us page. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

Salary Range:
$x - $x; Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted.

California Residents:
The pay range above is a reasonable estimate of salary based on pay scale, candidate experience, skills, and education. In addition to the comprehensive benefits noted above, the role may be eligible for bonus or commissions.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

Multi-Discipline Project Manager, Defence
PSO Program Manager, Community Connect
new_jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact
Axon Community Connect enables public safety agencies to build voluntary, policy-based partnerships with businesses and community members. Through camera registration and secure camera integration, the program expands investigative reach and real-time situational awareness during critical incidents while maintaining privacy, transparency, and camera-owner control.
As the PSO Program Manager, Community Connect, you will lead the operational health and scalable execution of the Community Connect program across Axon’s U.S. customer base and growing international footprint.
You will establish the operating discipline that enables Program Coordinators to deliver consistent agency outcomes. This includes maintaining visibility into program performance, work-order health, delivery dependencies, technical readiness, and customer-impacting risks; strengthening the processes, tools, and playbooks used across the team; and ensuring complex issues receive the appropriate cross-functional attention.
You will serve as a program-level escalation resource, coordinating with Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Finance to remove blockers and drive resolution. You will also provide consultative support for hardware deployment readiness, remote hardware configuration and activation, connectivity, and camera integration requirements.
Your work will enable agencies to launch and sustain Community Connect programs that extend operational visibility, strengthen community participation, and scale responsibly without compromising privacy or the customer experience.
What You’ll Do
Location:
Remote - PT or MT Time Zones 
Travel:
Approximately 30%
Reports to:
Manager, Program Management (Community Connect)
Partner with PSO leadership to implement scalable workflows, operating rhythms, documentation, and reporting that support consistent program delivery.
Maintain visibility into overall program performance, project status, delivery milestones, dependencies, and customer-impacting risks.
Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams to remove delivery blockers, manage escalations, and improve the customer experience.
Support work-order management and closure activities, including quality checks, documentation, and internal handoffs.
Serve as a technical resource for deployment planning, hardware readiness, network connectivity, configuration, and integration requirements.
Support the deployment of Cores placed in the field by Community Connect team members, including remote configuration, activation, validation, and onsite technical support when needed.
Troubleshoot hardware, network, connectivity, and video-integration issues; document findings and coordinate escalation with the appropriate technical resources to drive resolution.
Create and maintain technical readiness guidance, deployment checklists, troubleshooting resources, and escalation paths for common Community Connect deployment scenarios.
Develop and maintain playbooks, training materials, job aids, and knowledge resources that enable consistent team execution.
Identify recurring delivery, technical, and process issues; partner with leadership to implement improvements that strengthen program execution at scale.
Support adoption of new products, internal tools, and program updates by ensuring the team has clear guidance and readiness resources.

What You Bring
Bachelor’s degree in program management, project management, operations, information technology, professional services, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience, including 2+ years supporting customer-facing technical deployments, implementations, or professional-services programs involving remote hardware configuration, activation, troubleshooting, and field deployment coordination.
Working knowledge of hardware, networking, connectivity, and integration concepts—including IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, firewalls, ports, Wi-Fi, bandwidth, and basic troubleshooting—and the ability to translate technical findings into clear next steps.
Experience managing complex, customer-facing work involving multiple stakeholders, dependencies, risks, competing priorities, and technical escalations.
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to maintain clear documentation, coordinate across teams, and drive issues through resolution.
Experience developing and improving workflows, playbooks, technical guidance, training materials, and knowledge resources that enable consistent execution.
Proficiency with CRM, project-management, and workflow tools such as Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar platforms, as well as Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
Analytical mindset, with the ability to use data and feedback to identify trends, surface risks, and improve operational performance.
Experience in public safety, SaaS, video technology, physical security technology, connected hardware, or a comparable technical environment is preferred.
Must pass a Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) background check and maintain CJIS clearance.
Ability to handle confidential and highly sensitive information with discretion and sound judgment.

Benefits that Benefit You
Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
Discretionary paid time off
Paid parental leave for all
Medical, Dental, Vision plans
Fitness Programs
Emotional & Mental Wellness support
Learning & Development programs
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.
Base Pay Range: $68,100 USD - $108,960 USD
Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.
Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.
We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at  axongreenhousesupport@axon.com
 or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.
Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.
We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.
Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com
, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

new_jobs.description:
About Slate

At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.

| WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Slate is looking for an experienced Public Relations and Communications Program Manager to run the day-to-day and long-term operations of the communications department. Reporting to the Head of Public Relations and Communications, this role makes sure internal and external communications programs run on time, on brand, and in step with the rest of the business. The ideal candidate lives in the details.

| WHAT YOU GET TO DO

Communications Operations

Own the day-to-day and long-term operations of the communications department, including planning, timelines, and program tracking.
Build and maintain scalable processes and systems to keep the department organized as it grows.
Track budgets, deliverables, and deadlines across all active PR and communications programs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with the Marketing, Fleet, and Distribution teams within Commercial to align communications programs with broader business priorities.
Collaborate with Program Management, Design, and Engineering to ensure communications and PR needs are built into product and program timelines.
Serve as a key point of contact for cross-functional partners on communications planning and status.

Fleet & Event Readiness

Work with the internal fleet team to ensure vehicles are wrapped, accessorized, and ready ahead of events and media activations.
Coordinate timelines and requirements between the communications team and fleet operations to avoid last-minute gaps.
Track vehicle and asset readiness against the event and campaign calendar.

Brand Visibility & Opportunity Identification

Identify new opportunities for Slate to show up — at events, in media, and through partnerships — that align with brand goals.
Bring forward ideas and recommendations to leadership on where and how Slate should be present.
Monitor the broader industry and competitive landscape for opportunities and risks.

Program & Detail Management

Keep every workstream coordinated, documented, and on schedule, serving as the person who catches what others miss.
Maintain clear records, timelines, and status updates across all active programs.
Anticipate risks and proactively resolve conflicts before they affect deadlines.

Additional Responsibilities

Maintain accurate program documentation and records.
Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

| WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
7+ years of experience in program management, communications, or PR, with a track record of running programs independently.

Technical Skills

Proficiency in Smartsheets, Microsoft Office Suite and project management software.
Experience managing budgets, timelines, and vendor relationships.
Comfortable working across scheduling, tracking, and communications tools.

Core Competencies

Exceptional organizational skills and an obsessive attention to detail — nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Commercial, Program Management, Design, and Engineering.
Self-starter who identifies opportunities and brings ideas forward without being asked.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple programs and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

History of managing communications operations at a growing or fast-paced company.
History of cross-functional wins.

SALARY RANGE

The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors.

Annual Base Pay Range: $85,000 - $140,000

Location:

Remote ok- preferred in SoCal or Troy, MI

Additional Compensation And Benefits

Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs.

WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIREMENT

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship at this time.

WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?

At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles.

Safety First
Delight Customers
One Team
Relentless Improvement
Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy
Respectful Collaboration
Positive Legacy

WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.

Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

new_jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Project Manager, National Tax - Indirect Tax (Tax Technology & Transformation - Tax Project Management Office) (Manager) (Multiple Positions) (1739752), Ernst & Young U.S. LLP, Dallas, TX.

Assist clients and internal teams by establishing relationships with engagement leadership to design, establish and operate day to day program and governance structures tracking performance, status and benefit realization across workstreams. Oversee the design, implementation, and integration of technology solutions which enable tax departments to gather, organize and analyze high volumes of data. Monitor progress, manage risk, maximize operational efficiencies and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes. Support teams with experience in planning, controlling and executing complex programs. Oversee various processes and communicate status and progress of the day-to-day operations of the project on a regular basis. Aid in the effort of continuing to standardize and improve our internal processes and go-to-market approaches. Assist with the design and execution of transition plans for these transformational engagements.

Manage and motivate teams of professionals with diverse skills and backgrounds. Consistently deliver quality client services by monitoring progress. Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Maintain long-term client relationships and networks. Cultivate business development opportunities.

Full time employment, Monday – Friday, 40 hours per week, 8:30 am – 5:30 pm.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Must have a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Tax or a related field and 5 years of progressive, post-baccalaureate related work experience. Alternatively, will accept a Master’s degree in Accounting, Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Tax or a related field and 4 years of related work experience.

Must have 4 years of experience at a mid-sized/regional to large sized/national professional services firm, consulting firm, and/or public accounting firm.

Must have 4 years of experience establishing program governance structure, operating models, and transition/ transformation/implementation scope of services aligned to technology deployment.

Must have 4 years of experience using at least 1 of the following project execution strategies: Waterfall, SCRUM, Agile and/or SAFe Agile project methodologies.

Must have 4 years of experience building systems to monitor and report on performance, quality and effectiveness of program services, including adherence to established KPIs, CPIs and other contractual obligations.

Must have 4 years of experience with Microsoft Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint, Sharepoint and Visio.

Must have 3 years of experience designing, setting up and leading work streams for a large, complex program involving multiple related projects.

Must have 3 years of experience with the Microsoft Power BI suite, including PowerPivot, Power Query, Power View and Power Map.

Must have 2 years of experience supervising teams on multiple projects and providing direction to team members.

Must have 2 years of experience managing tax engagements, including engagement-related budgeting and billing, serving as a primary point of contact for clients, and escalating issues to tax partners or executives as needed.

Must hold at least one of the following certifications/accreditations: Certified Public Accountant (CPA); US State Bar license; Certified Digital Product Manager (CDPM); Lean Six Sigma Black Belt; Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Tax; Certified Member of the Institute (CMI); Certified Scrum Professional Certifications (CSPC); Certified SAFe Professionals; Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA); PMI Agile Certified Practitioner; Vertex Certified Implementer; Microsoft Certified Azure or DevOps Professional Certification; SQL Server Database Certification; and/or Microsoft Certified Power Platform App.

Requires domestic travel up to 25% to serve client needs.

Employer will accept any suitable combination of education, training or experience.

Please apply on-line at ey.com/en_us/careers and click on "Careers - Job Search”, “See All", then “Experienced Professionals” (Job Number - 1739752).

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive compensation and beneﬁts package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary for this job is $205,510.00 per year. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year. Under our ﬂexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, ﬁnancial, and emotional well-being.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis. If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The Exceptional EY Experience. It’s Yours To Build.

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could redefine what’s possible? With us, you can.

You want Purpose. Growth. Opportunity.
People who get it.

We are the home of ambitious, passionate, and innovative world shapers.

With an unmatched breadth and depth of engineering, advisory and science-based expertise, our global minds unite to power local solutions. We are pathfinders and impact makers.

We are Visioneers
. We are WSP
.

The Opportunity

Your Impact Starts Here
– Are you ready to tackle some of the most complex and rewarding challenges in the industry? In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with brilliant minds and contribute to high-profile projects that are changing the landscape of our world.

WSP’s RPM team is one of the most established and exciting teams in Canada. The team consists of environmental technicians, project coordinators, project managers, technical experts, and qualified professionals. We have been providing contaminated site program management services to the worlds most technically focused companies for over 15 years. We consistently have backlog of 9 to 12 months and provide growth opportunities for our high performing team members. We specialize in health and safety, Phase I/II ESAs, risk assessment and remediation. Our team takes on the biggest Canadian projects from coast to coast to coast. The projects range in type, size and complexity, and the successful candidate will be able to utilize the team strengths to manage a large amount of field work efficiently and effectively.

We're expanding and seeking an Environmental Remediation Project Manager. This role involves working with a dedicated team to manage contaminated downstream sites and achieve closure.

Your Impact

You collaborate within a team, working alongside Project Coordinators, other Project Managers, Senior Project Directors or Technical Leads, as well as Field Technicians, Scientists, and Engineers.
You have a strong commitment to health and safety, and steward best health and safety practices throughout your projects.
You have a client centric mind set and strive to provide excellent consulting services to clients.
You create proposals and cost estimates, organize schedules for field staff and subcontractors, gather data, and write reports that include conclusions and recommendations.
You manage project accounting and ensure tracking and reporting follow the terms outlined in WSP’s Master Services Agreements.
You mentor junior staff on environmental protocols and conduct site inspections to uphold safety and technical standards.
You communicate with clients to confirm their needs are addressed and that projects and proposals proceed with high quality.
You support fellow members of the Remediation Program Management Group, sharing responsibilities related to health and safety, project management, completion, and client service.

The Skills That Set You Apart

University degree or college diploma in engineering or environmental sciences.
Minimum 5 years of experience in contaminated site assessments and downstream experience is considered an asset with three years of project management experience.
Sound understanding of the need for health and safety procedures in the workplace/Possess a safety conscious attitude.
Strong field experience is considered an asset.
Understanding of the BC Environmental Management Act/Contaminated Sites Regulation.
Professional designation is preferred.

Why choose WSP?

We exist to shape communities to advance humanity. The brightest engineers, advisors and scientists from across the globe call WSP home.

Proudly Canadian – we are a Top 100 Employer in Canada for 2026
A global community of brilliant minds – your next idea, mentor, or opportunity is always within reach.
Limitless opportunities start here. Whether it’s across the country or around the globe, we’ll help you tailor your role to match your ambition—because your growth drives ours.
Flexible work, real balance – we recognize the importance of balance in our lives and encourage you to prioritize the balance in yours.

#WeAreWSP

Compensation

AB, BC, NT, NU, SK & YK:
$80,800 – $107,000

MB & ON:
$73,700 – $101,500

NB, NL, NS, PEI & QC:
$73,000 – $96,900

Disclosure:

The final salary awarded for this role may vary from the above range based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The wage range provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes.

Make Your Mark with WSP

If you're driven by purpose and impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and take the first step toward a rewarding career with us.

#WSP_RPM

About Us

At WSP
, we exist to shape communities to advance humanity.

It’s why we bring people together who are wired to solve complex challenges - engineers, scientists, advisors, and technical experts who are driven by a common passion - to redefine what’s possible and shape what comes next. We are Visioneers.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, we partner with clients across transportation, infrastructure, environment, buildings, energy, water, mining and metals. We pair deep local knowledge with global insights to pioneer solutions designed to leave a lasting, positive impact.

At WSP
, you’ll join a community of brilliant minds that push boundaries every day - applying deep expertise and fuelling innovation to help create a more connected and resilient future. Here, your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and you are encouraged to bring your authentic self to work. We empower our people to collaborate across disciplines, challenge the status quo, and shape a career with purpose.

Join us.

At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.
Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.
Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.
Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

Position Summary

As our Sr. Technical Program Manager - Product Development, you will sit in the driver's seat of our product delivery programs. You are the central traffic controller who leads the cross functional execution of product intent into shipped outcomes. Working closely with hardware, software, operations, and go-to-market teams, you will map out the optimal route for new product introductions: establishing the plan, driving alignment, surfacing tradeoffs, managing dependencies, and holding the organization accountable to scope, schedule, technical readiness, and launch quality. If you excel at transforming potential roadblocks into smooth, predictable execution without losing speed, this is your green light to lead.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Hardware, you will operate as the technical program integrator across Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Quality, and other key partners. On many programs, you will work alongside a second Technical Program Manager (TPgM) focused on detailed hardware execution. In that model, you would own the integrated product plan and cross-functional delivery system, while partnering closely with the hardware TPgM to keep hardware execution, software delivery, system integration, operational readiness, and go-to-market planning aligned. The Sr. Technical Program Manager does not replace functional technical leaders, but must understand the system deeply enough to connect decisions across disciplines, expose hidden dependencies early, and drive the right conversations at the right time.

Location:
This is a flexible hybrid role based out of our HQ in Kitchener Ontario.

Objectives And Responsibilities

Direct Flagship Delivery: Lead 1–3 concurrent complex product programs across hardware, firmware, cloud software, and operations to turn strategic vision into fully validated, commercially ready products.
Build Integrated Master Plans: Connect architecture, validation, release, and launch milestones into a single clear execution roadmap to maintain absolute visibility over critical paths and key dependencies.
Unify Cross-Functional Teams: Serve as the connective tissue between Engineering, Product Management, Quality, and Go-To-Market teams to keep all domain execution plans aligned.
Drive Risk & Tradeoff Mitigation: Identify system-level interdependencies and navigate tradeoffs between scope, cost, and schedule to resolve bottlenecks before they disrupt launch timelines.
Enforce Launch & Phase Readiness: Establish evidence-based entry/exit criteria for pilot builds and commercial releases to ensure flawless quality upon market release.
Optimize Program Governance: Elevate program management tools, decision logs, and cadence frameworks to increase predictability and accountability across the entire organization.

Ideal Profile

Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience leading complex, end-to-end product programs spanning hardware, firmware, software, and operational launch.
Systems Thinking & Technical Depth: Strong ability to evaluate how hardware, firmware, cloud, and operational decisions interact across the entire product ecosystem.
Integrated Product Delivery: Deep knowledge of hardware/software lifecycles, cross-domain integration, system validation, and commercial launch readiness.
Program Governance: Expertise in building and driving integrated master schedules, dependency maps, risk mitigation strategies, and executive-level reporting.
Technical Credibility: Skilled at engaging with technical leads, constructively challenging incomplete plans, and surfacing hidden risks or assumptions early.
Cross-Domain Collaboration: Experience partnering with engineering, product, operations, and quality teams to align roadmaps and shared deliverables.
Go-To-Market Execution: Demonstrated ability to coordinate technical, operational, and commercial workstreams through launch and initial customer adoption.
Leadership & Ambiguity: Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of driving clarity, consensus, and accountability in dynamic environments.

Additional Assets

Experience delivering connected devices or other products where hardware, firmware, cloud, and application releases must come together for a successful launch.
New Product Introduction (NPI), manufacturing ramp, regulatory compliance, and post-launch operational handoffs.
Background in a related industry such as transportation technology, IoT, edge systems, intelligent infrastructure, or similarly complex product environments.

What You’ll Achieve In Year One

Build Strong Partnerships: Establish clear ownership, trust, and a seamless collaborative model across hardware, software, operations, and cross-functional leadership.
Drive End-to-End Visibility: Create high-integrity tracking for program scope, dependencies, and risk—enabling proactive decision-making and eliminating late-stage surprises.
Deliver a Major Milestone: Successfully drive a significant product launch across technical, operational, and go-to-market teams with strict readiness criteria.
Raise the Bar for Delivery: Implement scalable planning frameworks, review mechanisms, and accountability structures that make future product launches faster and more predictable.

This posting is for an actual vacancy.

Your Rewards & Well-being

We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.

Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.
Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.
Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.
Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together!

meoSphere is SES’s next-generation Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) satellite constellation, designed to deliver secure connectivity services to government agencies, enterprises, and commercial customers. It will also provide high-speed broadband internet to eliminate global connectivity dead zones.

To accelerate development timelines, reduce costs, and ensure quality, SES is internalizing a critical segment of the satellite supply chain: the final integration of partner satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads, all within a cutting-edge manufacturing and test facility.

Role Description Summary

The Agile Technical Program Manager (ATPM) is responsible for leading the execution, planning, integration, agile delivery and overall programmatic performance of a major team/segment as part of the greater meoSphere Integrated Product Team (IPT).

Reporting to the VP Programme Management and matrixed into the relevant segment team, the ATPM forms a delivery leadership partnership with the segment Technical Lead, combining technical understanding with agile execution, conventional program controls, cross-segment integration and IPT leadership to ensure successful delivery of program objectives.

The ATPM is a key driver of SES's transformation towards a highly agile, collaborative and integrated way of working, enabling rapid learning cycles, continuous integration and delivery across the meoSphere programme.

Programme & Delivery Leadership

Lead planning, execution, and delivery of the assigned segment/team.
Partner with the Technical Lead to establish priorities, objectives, and delivery plans.
Drive alignment between technical activities, programme objectives, and business priorities.
Foster collaboration across segments and promote a One-Team culture across meoSphere and wider SES stakeholders.

Agile Execution

Foster a culture of innovation, speed and accountability, leveraging iterative development, rapid prototyping and continuous learning.
Support implementation of SAFe-inspired agile practices across the programme.
Facilitate Program Increment (PI) planning, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives for the assigned segment/team.
Drive transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement through agile delivery practices.
Monitor delivery performance against PI objectives, identify blockers, and drive resolution to maintain delivery commitments.

Programme Management

Manage scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, and change activities for the assigned segment.
Develop and maintain integrated delivery plans, milestone schedules and forecasts, ensuring early identification of delivery risks.
Coordinate dependencies across programme segments and external partners, driving timely resolution of integration and delivery risks.
Support programme reporting, forecasting and governance activities, providing clear visibility of delivery health and progress.

Stakeholder Management

Act as the primary programme interface for the assigned segment.
Engage with engineering, operations, procurement, finance, suppliers and leadership stakeholders.
Provide timely and accurate status, risk, dependency, and decision information to support effective programme execution.

KEY COMPETENCIES

Programme & Delivery Leadership. Drives execution, delivery outcomes and team accountability in a complex Agile environment.
Agile Delivery. Applies Agile practices to plan, prioritize and deliver work iteratively while adapting to changing programme needs.
Stakeholder Management & Influence. Builds alignment across technical and business stakeholders, communicating effectively and influencing without direct authority.
Cross-Functional Collaboration. Partners effectively across teams, functions and external partners to achieve shared programme objectives.
Systems Thinking. Understands interdependencies, integration points and programme-level impacts of decisions and trade-offs.
Risk & Issue Management. Proactively identifoes, manages and resolves risks, issues and delivery dependencies.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or another relevant technical discipline.
Typically 8+ years of relevant experience leading complex technical programmes, projects or engineering developments.
Experience delivering major subsystems, workstreams or integrated teams within a complex technical environment.
Strong programme and project management experience covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, resource and change management.
Strong understanding of systems engineering, integration and verification activities.
Practical experience working in Agile environments and applying Agile delivery practices.
Experience within the satellite, space, aerospace, telecommunications or similarly complex systems industries.

Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains or other large-scale Agile delivery frameworks.
Understanding of LEO, MEO and GEO satellite systems, ground infrastructure and network integration.
Experience using enterprise programme and project management tools to support planning, reporting and governance.
Professional certification in programme/project management, Agile delivery or systems engineering (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, PMI-ACP, Scrum, INCOSE).
Experience working within highly regulated, safety-critical or mission-critical engineering environments.

Other Key Requirements

Travel as required for project realization purposes

Second Source Qualification: Support the qualification process for second-source assembly, test, and critical BOM components (e.g., Substrate, memory), ensuring technical parity and supply chain resilience.
Sustaining Engineering: Ensure post-ramp stabilization and guard-band optimization. Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve field quality issues, process deviations, and manufacturing bottlenecks.
EOL Planning: Support the EOL process, including last-time-buy (LTB) coordination, inventory management, and customer transition planning.
Stakeholder Communication: Provide regular status updates to senior management regarding product health, cost-reduction initiatives, and supply chain risks.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field; Master's degree preferred.

Proven track record in managing silicon yield improvement, ECO processes, and manufacturing qualifications.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage complex technical issues.
Ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
Experience in managing product transitions and EOL strategies.

Experience with supply chain operations and vendor management.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Technical Project Manager (Compliance & Certifications) to coordinate, manage, and drive our technical compliance, security, and industry certification initiatives. In this role, you will be the operational engine behind our compliance roadmap—managing the rigid timelines of external audits while aligning execution across internal software development, IT/TechOps, and business operations cycles.

As a key member of our execution team, you will ensure that all compliance projects are structured, tracked, and reported in strict accordance with our corporate PMO Standards.

You will directly own and manage the planning, tracking, and execution of our annual Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation and SOC2 (Type 1 and Type 2) audits. This role provides the critical project management, compliance oversight, governance, and auditability necessary to keep all teams aligned and audit-ready.

Key Responsibilities

PMO Reporting & Project Standards
PMO Standards Alignment: Manage and structure all compliance, security, and certification project plans, trackers, and document repositories in accordance with established PMO methodologies and guidelines.
Standardized Status Reporting: Provide routine, structured progress reports, KPI dashboards, and project health updates (covering milestones, risks, and blockers) as defined by PMO reporting frameworks.
Risk & Issue Escalation: Actively track dependencies and risks, executing formal escalation paths per PMO standards when compliance milestones are in jeopardy.
Platform Management: Maintain up-to-date program trackers, schedules, and resource planning artifacts within central PMO tools (such as Asana or Jira) to ensure a single source of truth.
Hybrid Project Management & Governance
Milestone & Critical Path Tracking: Establish clear, phase-gate project plans for upcoming audits, mapping out the critical path for audit readiness, dry-runs, evidence lock-down, and formal evaluation windows.
Requirements Translation: Translate complex, rigid compliance controls (e.g., security protocols, data-filtering standards) into clear, actionable technical specifications, user stories, and development tasks.
Engineering Alignment: Partner with Security, TechOps, Data, and Engineering teams to slot compliance-related tasks and vulnerability remediations into active development cycles (sprints or Kanban) without disrupting the core product roadmap.
Cross-Functional Compliance Oversight: Oversee key operational controls managed by technical partner teams to ensure continuous audit readiness.
Audit Coordination & Evidence Gathering
Audit Liaison: Serve as the primary operational contact and liaison for external auditors and assessors (e.g., MRC, EY, SOC2 auditors), ensuring meetings, requests, and inquiries are managed efficiently.
Evidence Management: Project manage the continuous gathering, formatting, and submission of technical evidence (configurations, access logs, architectural diagrams) required for SOC2 and MRC evaluations.
Remediation Tracking: Monitor and drive the resolution of any compliance gaps, audit findings, or vulnerability remediation tasks identified during pre-audits or continuous monitoring.
Media Rating Council (MRC) Certification Support
Audit Lifecycle Management: Project manage the end-to-end timeline for annual MRC audits, pre-assessment phases, and ongoing compliance reviews.
Adtech & Measurement Standards: Coordinate engineering and product tasks related to data pipelines, measurement methodologies, and filtration logic to ensure strict alignment with MRC and industry measurement standards.
Disclosure & Change Governance: Coordinate the preparation, maintenance, and regular updating of methodology disclosures, and establish a "Journal of Change" process to manage and communicate changes to accredited elements with MRC and auditor representatives.
Business Operations Alignment: Project manage compliance workflows across business operations required by MRC standards, including Business Partner Qualification (BPQ/client vetting), client onboarding/support disclosures, and discrepancy/data reissuance tracking.
SOC2 Type 1 & Type 2 Support
Audit Execution: Organize the schedule, operational execution, and readiness milestones for annual SOC2 Type 1 and Type 2 audits.
Controls Integration: Partner with engineering and IT teams to ensure system monitoring, access control reviews, and infrastructure configurations are consistently maintained and documented according to SOC2 Trust Services Criteria.
Automation Management: Help manage and monitor compliance automation tooling (e.g., Vanta, Drata) to ensure continuous control verification and evidence tracking.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience: 5 years of experience as a Technical Project Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Manager in a SaaS, Adtech, or software engineering environment.

Hybrid PM Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage fixed-deadline, structured compliance timelines (milestone/waterfall approach) while integrating execution into Agile-operating engineering teams.
Compliance & Governance: Practical experience managing projects, timelines, evidence gathering, or compliance oversight related to SOC2 audits or Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation.
Project Tracking Platforms: Advanced proficiency in structured project planning and execution tracking within platforms like Asana or Jira.
Technical Literacy: Comfort working alongside engineering and IT teams; ability to understand cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS/GCP), database schemas, and identity/access management frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

Adtech Background: Deep understanding of ad-serving technology, measurement methodologies, and industry measurement standards.
Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional), CAPM, PMI-ACP, or introductory security/compliance credentials.
Compliance Tooling: Experience using compliance automation platforms (e.g., Drata, Vanta, Secureframe) to track control verification and evidence gathering.

Lead complex global information security programs and projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring scope, plans, milestones, risks, budgets and outcomes are actively managed.
Translate enterprise security objectives into clear execution plans that support business value, measurable benefits and risk reduction.
Coordinate cross-functional and geographically distributed teams across Information Security, Enterprise Technology, Client Technology, Member Firms, vendors and contractors.
Drive project governance, status reporting, issue escalation and decision-making with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors.
Develop and manage detailed project plans, timelines, dependencies and RAID items using project management platforms and tools such as MS Project, Azure DevOps, or equivalent tools.
Identify risks, issues, interdependencies and resource constraints across programs, busy seasons and organizational priorities, and develop pragmatic mitigation plans.
Facilitate stakeholder alignment by integrating feedback, resolving conflicts and keeping teams focused on shared outcomes.
Support continuous improvement of security processes, governance practices and delivery methods, including lessons learned and sustainable operating models.
Mentor and coach project team members, build team engagement, and encourage accountability, collaboration and quality delivery.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To succeed in this role, you will need to combine information security knowledge, disciplined program delivery, and strong executive presence. The strongest candidates will demonstrate:

Technical and security knowledge: Understanding of information security technologies, including cloud, network, perimeter, messaging, endpoint and data security, along with familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001 and CIS Controls.
Project management depth: Proven ability to manage complex information security projects, including iterative and waterfall delivery methods, planning, budget management, risk management and stakeholder governance.
Leadership without authority: Ability to build trusted relationships, motivate teams, establish a shared vision and drive delivery across teams that do not directly report to the role.
Executive communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify technical matters for non-technical stakeholders and present concise, data-driven updates to senior leadership.
Stakeholder engagement: Ability to engage executive leadership and key stakeholders, understand competing priorities and negotiate alignment at multiple levels of the organization.
Risk and issue management: Ability to anticipate delivery risks, assess business impact, make timely recommendations and drive mitigation through structured plans.
Problem solving: Strong analytical thinking, critical judgment, creativity and conflict-resolution skills in time-sensitive or ambiguous situations.
Global mindset: Comfort operating across cultures, geographies, Member Firms and organizational structures, including awareness of political, regulatory and commercial factors that may affect delivery.

To qualify for the role you must have

Proven experience leading complex global information security, technology or risk-related programs from initiation to closure.
Strong understanding of information security technologies and operating environments, including cloud, network, endpoint, messaging and data security domains.
Experience managing project plans, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, budgets and executive reporting for complex initiatives.
Knowledge of security frameworks, standards and risk management methodologies, including NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or comparable frameworks.
Experience working with senior stakeholders and executive sponsors, including preparing clear status updates, recommendations and escalation materials.
Ability to lead cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive outcomes through influence, structure and accountability.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics in business terms.
Experience identifying interdependencies across other programs, operational timelines, business cycles and organizational priorities.
Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment with multiple stakeholder groups and competing priorities.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Relevant certifications such as PMP, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with project management and delivery platforms such as MS Project, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
Experience supporting compliance, privacy or regulatory requirements, including Privacy Impact Assessments and GDPR-related considerations.
Experience improving security processes, practices and governance models in a global enterprise environment.
Experience supporting security initiatives that align to business strategy, operational resilience and measurable risk reduction.
Familiarity with vendor and contractor coordination in support of complex technology or security programs.

What We Look For

We are looking for a seasoned Information Security project leader who can bring structure to complexity, communicate with clarity, and deliver outcomes through influence. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with senior leaders, global teams and diverse stakeholders; will be able to connect security priorities to business value; and will lead with accountability, sound judgment and a strong focus on execution. Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the leading cloud provider of virtualized infrastructure, storage, networking, messaging, and many other services all over the world. Our customers trust us to handle their data with air-tight security measures, which is something that we guarantee.

The AWS Data Center Security team is looking for a creative, innovative, results-oriented program manager in Georgia/Atlanta area to lead security and security-systems projects and programs in the data center environment. The ideal candidate will be able to contribute to a collaborative and productive environment with a strong service-oriented culture among multiple diverse and highly skilled teams of project and program managers. These teams are responsible for the design, installation, and evolution of physical security systems and programs to include intrusion detection, access control/management, CCTV, screening, emergency response, etc.

A successful candidate will have the ability to manage difficult and interdependent projects with a regional impact. You will be responsible for enabling the interpretation of Threat Assessments and AWS Physical Security Standards to assure the proper security mitigations are selected and implemented to meet the unique challenges in each area. You will be responsible for collaborating cross-functionally to assure each data center meets the high standards AWS sets for physical security. You must also ensure local security teams have the technical knowledge and resources necessary to meet the ongoing physical security mission.

Key job responsibilities

Project Management for physical security systems related to new construction, expansion, and retrofit projects.
Preparation of physical security project lifecycle management including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budget, change orders, and close-out documentation.
Contemporary knowledge of emerging physical security technologies to assess their applicability within the AWS physical security program.
Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) support for leadership to make strategic decisions regarding technology and procedure.
Balance performance metrics such as physical security system installation vendor service delivery performance, actual spend vs. budget variance, cost reduction goal attainment, post installation defect rates, physical security program analysis, etc.
Manage vendors for the on-boarding, RFQ, bid, contract, QA/QC, and support processes.
Effectively and accurately manage multi-million dollar budgets for infrastructure projects and initiatives.
Collaborate across teams and provide support for global initiatives.

About The Team

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Preferred Qualifications

Ability to communicate/brief effectively with both technical and non-technical individuals regarding physical security standards and system designs.
Experience in the delivery of physical security projects or programs within an enterprise setting.
Background in any of the following: Physical Security Design, Security Systems Deployment, Physical Security Operations, Security Architecture, Construction Management

Demonstrated ability to successfully influence stakeholders without formal authority, leading cross functional teams across geographies and business units
PSP, CPP, PMP Certification; Training in Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED), Certification or experience with Lenel Access Control System.

Strong understanding of threat and vulnerability analysis, digital forensics, evidence preservation, chain of custody, and technologies such as SIEM, endpoint security, threat intelligence, and vulnerability management platforms.
