new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Compliance & Certifications)
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Technical Project Manager (Compliance & Certifications) to coordinate, manage, and drive our technical compliance, security, and industry certification initiatives. In this role, you will be the operational engine behind our compliance roadmap—managing the rigid timelines of external audits while aligning execution across internal software development, IT/TechOps, and business operations cycles.

As a key member of our execution team, you will ensure that all compliance projects are structured, tracked, and reported in strict accordance with our corporate PMO Standards.

You will directly own and manage the planning, tracking, and execution of our annual Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation and SOC2 (Type 1 and Type 2) audits. This role provides the critical project management, compliance oversight, governance, and auditability necessary to keep all teams aligned and audit-ready.

Key Responsibilities

PMO Reporting & Project Standards
PMO Standards Alignment: Manage and structure all compliance, security, and certification project plans, trackers, and document repositories in accordance with established PMO methodologies and guidelines.
Standardized Status Reporting: Provide routine, structured progress reports, KPI dashboards, and project health updates (covering milestones, risks, and blockers) as defined by PMO reporting frameworks.
Risk & Issue Escalation: Actively track dependencies and risks, executing formal escalation paths per PMO standards when compliance milestones are in jeopardy.
Platform Management: Maintain up-to-date program trackers, schedules, and resource planning artifacts within central PMO tools (such as Asana or Jira) to ensure a single source of truth.
Hybrid Project Management & Governance
Milestone & Critical Path Tracking: Establish clear, phase-gate project plans for upcoming audits, mapping out the critical path for audit readiness, dry-runs, evidence lock-down, and formal evaluation windows.
Requirements Translation: Translate complex, rigid compliance controls (e.g., security protocols, data-filtering standards) into clear, actionable technical specifications, user stories, and development tasks.
Engineering Alignment: Partner with Security, TechOps, Data, and Engineering teams to slot compliance-related tasks and vulnerability remediations into active development cycles (sprints or Kanban) without disrupting the core product roadmap.
Cross-Functional Compliance Oversight: Oversee key operational controls managed by technical partner teams to ensure continuous audit readiness.
Audit Coordination & Evidence Gathering
Audit Liaison: Serve as the primary operational contact and liaison for external auditors and assessors (e.g., MRC, EY, SOC2 auditors), ensuring meetings, requests, and inquiries are managed efficiently.
Evidence Management: Project manage the continuous gathering, formatting, and submission of technical evidence (configurations, access logs, architectural diagrams) required for SOC2 and MRC evaluations.
Remediation Tracking: Monitor and drive the resolution of any compliance gaps, audit findings, or vulnerability remediation tasks identified during pre-audits or continuous monitoring.
Media Rating Council (MRC) Certification Support
Audit Lifecycle Management: Project manage the end-to-end timeline for annual MRC audits, pre-assessment phases, and ongoing compliance reviews.
Adtech & Measurement Standards: Coordinate engineering and product tasks related to data pipelines, measurement methodologies, and filtration logic to ensure strict alignment with MRC and industry measurement standards.
Disclosure & Change Governance: Coordinate the preparation, maintenance, and regular updating of methodology disclosures, and establish a "Journal of Change" process to manage and communicate changes to accredited elements with MRC and auditor representatives.
Business Operations Alignment: Project manage compliance workflows across business operations required by MRC standards, including Business Partner Qualification (BPQ/client vetting), client onboarding/support disclosures, and discrepancy/data reissuance tracking.
SOC2 Type 1 & Type 2 Support
Audit Execution: Organize the schedule, operational execution, and readiness milestones for annual SOC2 Type 1 and Type 2 audits.
Controls Integration: Partner with engineering and IT teams to ensure system monitoring, access control reviews, and infrastructure configurations are consistently maintained and documented according to SOC2 Trust Services Criteria.
Automation Management: Help manage and monitor compliance automation tooling (e.g., Vanta, Drata) to ensure continuous control verification and evidence tracking.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience: 5 years of experience as a Technical Project Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Manager in a SaaS, Adtech, or software engineering environment.
PMO Alignment: Proven experience managing projects and reporting project health, timelines, and status updates in alignment with structured PMO frameworks.
Hybrid PM Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage fixed-deadline, structured compliance timelines (milestone/waterfall approach) while integrating execution into Agile-operating engineering teams.
Compliance & Governance: Practical experience managing projects, timelines, evidence gathering, or compliance oversight related to SOC2 audits or Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation.
Project Tracking Platforms: Advanced proficiency in structured project planning and execution tracking within platforms like Asana or Jira.
Technical Literacy: Comfort working alongside engineering and IT teams; ability to understand cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS/GCP), database schemas, and identity/access management frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

Adtech Background: Deep understanding of ad-serving technology, measurement methodologies, and industry measurement standards.
Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional), CAPM, PMI-ACP, or introductory security/compliance credentials.
Compliance Tooling: Experience using compliance automation platforms (e.g., Drata, Vanta, Secureframe) to track control verification and evidence gathering.

US Benefits & Perks

Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
Regular company events and activities
Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
401k Plan – 4% employee match
Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

About The Team

The Hybrid Cloud organization is responsible for driving the strategy, delivery, and operational excellence of RBC’s cloud footprint across AWS, Azure, and On-Premise environments. The Technical Program Management team sits at the center of this effort - translating business priorities into coordinated technical delivery, removing cross-team friction, and ensuring our engineering organization ships reliable, secure, and compliant infrastructure and platform capabilities at scale.

About The Role

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager who combines strong program management fundamentals with hands-on fluency in Agile delivery and cloud technology, and who is excited to apply AI tools thoughtfully to make program delivery faster, more consistent, and more scalable.

This is not a “traditional” program manager role. You'll be expected to actively identify where AI-enabled workflows - for reporting, risk detection, status synthesis, documentation, dependency mapping, and more - can reduce manual overhead and improve the quality and repeatability of program execution, while maintaining the judgment and stakeholder trust that only an experienced program manager brings.

You will work across a matrixed set of stakeholders - engineering, product management, business sponsors, finance, risk, and compliance - to plan, sequence, and deliver hybrid cloud initiatives that meet the rigor expected in a regulated financial environment.

What will you do?

Own end-to-end program management for hybrid cloud initiatives spanning AWS, Azure, and On-Premise environments - from intake and planning through execution, delivery, and closure.
Apply Agile practices and methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across multiple teams to drive agile planning, flow management, continuous refinement, and continuous delivery/integration.
Partner with engineering, product, business, and finance stakeholders to align priorities, manage dependencies, and communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs clearly and proactively.
Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-enabled tools and workflows to improve the efficiency, consistency, and repeatability of program management practices (e.g., automated status reporting, AI-assisted risk/dependency identification, meeting synthesis, documentation generation).
Establish and maintain program governance artifacts - roadmaps, RAID logs, dashboards, and executive-level reporting - with an eye toward automation and self-service where possible.
Facilitate cross-team ceremonies (planning, syncs, retrospectives) that keep distributed technical teams aligned and unblocked.
Drive continuous improvement of team delivery practices, coaching teams on Agile and DevOps principles (CI/CD, flow metrics, WIP management).
Manage escalations and resolve cross-team conflicts, balancing technical constraints, business priorities, and regulatory/compliance requirements.
Contribute to the maturity of the technical program management function itself - helping define what “AI-enabled program management” looks like as a practice within the organization.

What Do You Need to Succeed?

Program Management

Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager or Program Manager, ideally within a financial institution or another highly technical, regulated environment.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent, cross-functional programs with competing priorities and dependencies.
Strong communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders across business and technology.

Agile & Delivery Practices

Deep, applied knowledge of Agile frameworks - Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe - including experience implementing and scaling these across multiple teams.
Hands-on experience with agile planning, flow management, continuous refinement, and continuous delivery/continuous integration practices.
Required experience with Jira and Confluence for program tracking, planning, and documentation.
Familiarity with metrics that support flow and delivery management (velocity, cycle time, throughput, flow efficiency).

Technical & Cloud Fluency

Solid working knowledge of cloud technologies and hybrid cloud architectures - AWS, Azure, and On-Premise infrastructure.
Comfortable engaging in technical conversations with engineering teams on topics like infrastructure, migrations, platform services, and cloud cost/operations, without needing to be a hands-on engineer.

AI-Enabled Ways of Working

Practical experience using AI tools (e.g., generative AI assistants) to improve personal or team productivity - reporting, documentation, synthesis, or workflow automation.
A thoughtful, judgment-driven approach to applying AI: knowing where it adds real efficiency and repeatability, and where human oversight and expertise remain essential.
Curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset toward emerging AI capabilities relevant to program and delivery management.
Nice to have: familiarity with GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and Visual Studio Code. Prior use of these specific tools is not required, but experience with similar AI-assisted platforms is a strong plus.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Experience partnering effectively with stakeholders across engineering, product management, business, and finance functions.
Ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences, and to build trust across diverse stakeholder groups.

Nice-to-have

Experience in a financial services, banking, or other highly regulated industry.
Relevant certifications (PgMP, SAFe Agilist, ACSM, KMP, or equivalent).
Familiarity with cloud governance, cost optimization, or FinOps practices.
Experience building or piloting internal AI-enabled tooling or workflows for program/portfolio management.

What’s in it for you?

You'll help shape how RBC’s Hybrid Cloud organization delivers - combining rigorous program management with the practical, forward-looking use of AI to make delivery smarter, not just faster. You'll have visibility across engineering, product, and business leadership, and a real opportunity to define what modern, AI-enabled technical program management looks like in a regulated enterprise environment.

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

As part of the Global Operations Team – all business professionals at the firm – you’ll collaborate with colleagues from varied backgrounds and experiences, fostering an environment where cross-functional learning, networking, and collaboration are at the core of what we do.

Here, we’re not just supporting a law firm; we’re partnering with attorneys and clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions
in high-stakes litigation and dispute resolution, world-class regulatory compliance and advisory services, and complex transactions. Our commitment to integrity, ingenuity, agility, and ambition drives us, and we’re proud to have been recognised as the “Best Business Team” by The American Lawyer.

This is your opportunity to grow professionally in a dynamic, global environment, surrounded by forward-thinking peers.

This position will provide support of the Industry Group (IG) and Practice Group (PG) Business Operations teams, and will oversee certain processes that are critical firm priorities. The position works under the direction of the Managing Director and Industry Business Lead for Life Sciences and works closely with partners, leaders, and administrative team members across Industry Groups and Practice Groups to ensure timely and effective execution on processes and systems that support the strategic direction of the Business Operations function firmwide. This role will require a versatile, self-directed team player, a well-rounded, skilled operator who is facile with technology and has excellent organizational and communication skills. This role will work closely with diverse groups that may evolve over time and who can serve as a facilitator across the Business Operations teams. An interest and ability to thrive and perform at a high level in a dynamic environment with multiple constituencies is needed to succeed in this role.

What You Will Do

Work with the Managing Director and Industry Business Lead, IG leaders, PG leaders, and Business Operations teams to manage operational and strategic aspects of the business, including internal organization, meetings, information and data management, executing on deliverables in connection with firm processes, and other initiatives as requested. Identify IG and PG needs and opportunities, and work to advance relevant initiatives, providing general coverage across groups as needed.
Support the functional management of the Business Operations team, including expense budget tracking and oversight of the budgeting process for the Business Operations function. Assist with Business Practice optimization efforts to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Business Operations processes firmwide.
Support processes that cut across Industry Groups and Practice Groups, including oversight of and compliance with Partner Delinquent Time policies, and maintaining a calendar of general firm reminders to Partners. Take on other cross-functional projects and priorities as needed from time to time.
Provide general operational support across Industry Groups, Practice Groups, and Practice Areas. Groups that this role supports may change from time to time based on business needs and corporate structure.

Who You Are

5 to 7 years' experience in Business Operations/Practice Management in a large law firm.
J.D. and experience as an attorney, in a large law firm preferred.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Well-rounded and versatile — a skilled, adaptable operator able to work effectively as a facilitator across multiple Business Operations teams.
Facile with technology, with the ability to learn and adopt new tools and systems quickly.
Develop and foster positive, collaborative working relationships.
Exercise sound judgment while respecting, protecting, and maintaining highly confidential and sensitive information.
Manage projects and tasks effectively, applying strong delegation and organizational skills.
Apply creative problem-solving and effective people-management skills.

new_jobs.description:
Ready für deinen nächsten Karrieresprung?

Dann werde Teil unseres motivierten Teams im Headquarter in München und bring’ deine Eigeninitiative ein, damit unsere internen Prozesse laufen wie ein gut gepflegtes Laufband. Du übernimmst eine zentrale Funktion in den Bereichen Forecasting, Reporting und treibst die operative Exzellenz in unseren Märkten aktiv voran. Gleichzeitig sorgst du mit einem sicheren Gespür für Organisation und Teamdynamik dafür, dass interne Events und Meetings nicht nur reibungslos ablaufen, sondern echte Highlights im Arbeitsalltag sind.

Dein tägliches Workout

Business Operations: Du stellst reibungslose und effiziente Prozesse in unseren direkten Märkten (DACH, UK, Iberia und Frankreich) sicher und fungierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Sales und Business Management
Forecasting & Budget: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Erstellung und das Monitoring unserer Forecasts und Budgets, um eine verlässliche Planung und Umsetzung unserer Unternehmensziele zu gewährleisten
Reporting: Du analysierst regelmäßig Profit & Loss Kennzahlen und trackst die Pipeline-Entwicklung, um datenbasierte Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten und strategische Entscheidungen zu unterstützen
Onboarding: Du bist aktiv in die Einarbeitung neuer Teammitglieder eingebunden und sorgst dafür, dass sie alle relevanten Tools, Prozesse und Ansprechpartner kennenlernen
Events & Koordination: Du planst und koordinierst interne Veranstaltungen sowie Teammeetings und trägst zu einer motivierenden, strukturierten und kollaborativen Arbeitsatmosphäre bei

Dein Fitness Level

Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Business Operations, Sales Operations oder einem ähnlichen Umfeld und verfügst über relevanten theoretischen Background - idealerweise durch ein abgeschlossenes Wirtschaftsstudium
Kontaktfreude: Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen, kommunizierst offen und bist ein echter Teamplayer
Detailorientierung: Du hast ein Auge fürs Detail und scheust Dich nicht, tiefer in komplexe Themen einzutauchen, um nachhaltige Lösungen zu finden
Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du bringst ein starkes Zahlenverständnis mit und kannst Daten präzise aufbereiten sowie interpretieren
Organisationstalent: Du behältst auch in einem dynamischen Umfeld den Überblick über verschiedene Projekte und Deadlines
Digital Affinity: Du bist mit Tools wie Tableau, Salesforce, Notion, Google Suite und MS Office bestens vertraut und fühlst Dich im Umgang mit ihnen wohl. AI Tools wie Claude sind mittlerweile täglicher Begleiter deiner Arbeit, die du effizient einsetzt
Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst sicher in Deutsch und Englisch, um Dich im internationalen Umfeld souverän und professionell zu bewegen

Dein Trainingsziel für Deine ersten 6 Monate

Überblick: Du hast einen vollständigen Überblick über unsere Organisationsstrukturen erlangt und stellst sicher, dass sämtliche Prozesse in unseren direkten und indirekten Märkten effizient ineinandergreifen
Forecast & Reporting: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team robuste Forecasts und erstellst relevante Dashboards/Reports, um Budget- sowie Umsatzentwicklungen transparent zu machen
Prozessoptimierung: Du hast mindestens zwei bestehende Prozesse analysiert, Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten identifiziert und konkrete Konzepte für eine nachhaltige Anpassung erarbeitet
Team-Onboarding: Du hast das Onboarding unserer neuen Kolleg*innen optimiert und sorgst für eine einheitliche, strukturierte Einarbeitung in alle relevanten Tools und Prozesse

Unser Trainingsequipment

Unternehmenskultur: Erlebe ein internationales Umfeld, das Diversität und kulturellen Austausch aktiv lebt
Fitness & Gesundheit: Profitiere von kostenfreiem Zugang zu EGYM Wellpass sowie zu unserem firmeneigenen Fitnessstudio, ausgestattet mit den neuesten EGYM Geräten
Mentoring-Programm: Nutze unsere selbstorganisierte Mentoring-Plattform, um Wissen zu teilen und gemeinsam über Teams und Standorte hinweg zu wachsen
Work-Life-Balance: Genieße 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell
Flex Budget: Nutze 60€ pro Monat flexibel für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel und Essenszuschuss
Benefitportal: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten - von Mode bis Freizeit
Bike Leasing über Lease a Bike: Nutze unser Bike-Leasing-Angebot, um aktiv zu bleiben, sei es auf dem Arbeitsweg oder in Deiner Freizeit
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Sichere Deine Zukunft mit unserer attraktiven betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
Kaffee & Obst: Genieße kostenlosen Kaffee, Tee und frisches Obst in unserem modernen, klimatisierten Büro und entspanne auf unserer großen Terrasse während der Mittagspause

new_jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Solution Architect / Technical Program Manager

Solution Architect cum Project Manager

All About Us

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing support that helps our customers grow. This team is responsible for delivering end-to-end solutions to a diverse, global customer base. We combine traditional management consulting with our rich data assets and proprietary technology to offer clients powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Our suite of services is anchored in data-driven technology and innovation, encompassing consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, test-and-learn business experimentation, and comprehensive data-based information and risk management services. While our primary expertise is in the payments industry, Mastercard Services collaborates with major retailers, airlines, and other enterprises, leveraging insights derived from both within and outside our extensive network.

All About The Role

Make an Impact as a Managing Consultant, Digital Labs

Skills

Digital Labs is a client-facing, execution-oriented team that leverages accredited change management skills and domain expertise to partner with clients and generate measurable value by:

Developing new products and strategies to bring them to market efficiently and seamlessly
Successfully design tailored solutions, implementing complex technology assets and delivering challenging transformation programs to establish new standards for business operations
Building clients’ internal skills, knowledge, and experience in critical domains
Transforming client processes and optimizing management practices

As a Managing Consultant, you will oversee a portfolio of projects that align with strategic changes or initiatives, each with significant organizational impact. You will manage complexities and inherent risks across a broad spectrum of business areas, where strong interdependencies and resource sharing are common. Your responsibilities include managing benefits from their initial identification and definition through to full realization and measurable improvement.

This position requires an intersection of two disciplines: demonstrated excellence in project management as well as in-depth technical knowledge across IT topics such as software development, APIs, IT and enterprise architecture, and IT service management. Leadership in project management and stakeholder engagement is essential, as is the ability to manage large, multi-party teams. A strong grasp of current trends in IT development, architecture, and service processes is also crucial.

All About You

Demonstrated experience delivering large-scale digital enterprise programs in the financial services sector, from initiation through to benefit realization
Analyze business requirements and design tailored solutions leveraging platform functionalities. Provide technical consultation and validate solutions through proofs of concept and feasibility assessments
Proven leadership of PMOs across varied clients and businesses, including risk identification and mitigation, issue resolution, plan development, and adherence to agreed timelines, budgets, and quality standards—with examples of adjusting scope and objectives to maximize program value
Formal accreditation in recognized PM/PMO, change, or service management methodologies is expected; experience with Agile methodologies and/or as a scrum master is advantageous
Ability to develop and maintain strong client relationships, serve as a go-to resource for client staff, and be sought after for industry and firm expertise Identify new business opportunities and communicate them to executives for pursuit; begin leading sales efforts and contribute to proposals and new client development Analyze various aspects of clients’ organizational systems and cultures as input into stakeholder mapping and sales processes
Effectively leverage subject matter experts to design optimal solutions for clients
Exemplary interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to direct multiple workstreams across large, multifaceted project teams
Strong writing, presentation, and public speaking abilities, with the capacity to influence at all organizational levels. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to articulate customer opportunities in financial terms, including value quantification, effort estimation, and scope definition
Demonstrated initiative and adaptability in developing solutions or modifying approaches to achieve defined objectives and benefits; ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Work closely with the technical team to facilitate smooth implementation and customization of solutions. Collaborate with development, QA, and sales teams to address client requirements.
Efficiently allocate and manage technical resources, ensuring project teams have the necessary skills and tools to fulfill their responsibilities
Exhibit authentic leadership and integrity, demonstrate gravitas, and lead multidisciplinary teams in a matrixed environment; mentor staff, evaluate performance, and provide constructive feedback; achieve team consensus around business goals
Experience with building functional specifications is a plus

All About Your Education & Skills

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification required; advanced degree or MBA preferred
Professional accreditation such as Project Management Professional (PMP) is desirable
7+ years of experience in a similar role, with a proven record of managing successful projects
Experience implementing full tech stack solutions across various technology tiers: channels, middleware, back-end, and front-end
Demonstrated expertise in both Agile/Scrum and waterfall project management methodologies, with the ability to manage complex projects within the financial services sector
Extensive experience in solution architecture, with a focus on cards and payment solutions within financial services.
Deep knowledge of payment processing, card management systems, payment gateways, and standards such as EMV, PCI DSS, ISO 8583, AS2805 and ISO 20022.
Hands-on experience with integration technologies (e.g., APIs, microservices, middleware) and secure payments infrastructure.
Strong understanding of security, compliance, and regulatory requirements in the payments domain.
Proven ability to design and document complex architectures and integration patterns.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with agile delivery methodologies and DevOps practices.
Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern technology stacks is highly regarded.
Able to design and implement enterprise-level architectural artefacts including business capability models, value stream maps, solution blueprints leveraging frameworks such as TOGAF, BABOK and BPMN.
Comfortable with high levels of client interaction and focused on developing strong relationships

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Professional Services
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:

Austin, US
San Francisco, CA
New York, NY

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and seasoned Senior Project Manager to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will lead the governance and end-to-end execution of complex, high-stakes migration and implementation projects for our most strategic customers. Serving as the primary bridge between sales, technical delivery teams, and executive stakeholders, you will ensure that sophisticated cybersecurity and networking solutions are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with agreed success criteria for minimal-disruption or zero-/low-downtime outcomes.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience in professional services, SaaS or cloud technology delivery, project management, and executive-level customer relationship management. We believe that putting our people first and fostering a creative, exciting, and stimulating environment is a prerequisite to achieving our commercial goals.

Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional teams of technical professionals, consultants, FDE’s, partners, vendors, and customer stakeholders to deliver complex consulting and multi-workstream implementation services in mission-critical enterprise environments.
Own project governance across the full project lifecycle, including project charters, scope definition, success criteria, delivery plans, RAID management, stakeholder communications, change control, acceptance criteria, and closeout / lessons learned.
Establish and maintain high-trust relationships with key customers, partners, and vendors to drive long-term satisfaction, adoption, and revenue growth.
Ensure Professional Services engagements are delivered on time and within budget by actively managing project financials, resource forecasts, scope performance, timeline performance, change requests, and executive reporting.
Develop, implement, and refine scalable methodologies, playbooks, templates, and best practices that improve the global efficiency and effectiveness of Professional Services delivery.
Ensure a seamless and consultative sales-to-delivery transition by validating scope, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and customer success criteria before project kickoff.
Proactively identify project risks, including zero- or low-downtime migrations, multi-vendor dependencies, resource constraints, scope changes, and customer operational impact, and implement mitigation strategies to protect customer outcomes.
Transform raw project data into clear, data-driven insights and regular status narratives for internal and external leadership regarding project health, risks, decisions, financials, and resource utilization.
Proactively leverage AI tools to optimize project workflows and technical delivery, serving as a force multiplier for project teams by streamlining administrative work, improving visibility, and increasing overall project productivity.
Collaborate across Account Teams, Customer Engineers, Support, Product, Engineering, Professional Services leadership, and other internal stakeholders to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and maintain a unified one-team approach to delivery.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience

Project and Portfolio Management: Mastery of project and portfolio management (PPM) principles, with the ability to oversee a high volume of concurrent workstreams while maintaining strategic alignment with customer and business objectives.
Strategic Execution: Proven ability to manage ambiguity, shifting priorities, and competing stakeholder needs while maintaining disciplined prioritization, scoping, and delivery governance.
Executive Presence: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the credibility and gravitas to influence C-suite stakeholders, lead through persuasion, and communicate complex delivery topics clearly.
Ambiguity and Operational Craftsmanship: Proven ability to remain effective and organized in an evolving environment where processes are still being defined. We are looking for a builder who can identify gaps in the current delivery lifecycle and proactively establish the governance frameworks, playbooks, and internal standards necessary to scale the organization.
Technical Literacy: Working knowledge of how the Internet works, including networking, security, Zero Trust / SASE, DNS, APIs, and related technologies. This person should be able to partner effectively with technical delivery teams without needing to be the technical owner.
AI-Enabled Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tooling responsibly to improve project planning, summarization, risk identification, reporting, and team productivity.
Change Management: Experience in organizational change management, including guiding enterprise customers through the cultural and operational shifts required by digital transformation and technology migration programs.
Conflict Resolution: Advanced skills in managing friction within project teams, across internal stakeholders, or with customers to reach mutually beneficial outcomes.
Collaborative Leadership: Proven ability to navigate and influence a complex matrix of internal stakeholders, including Account Teams, Customer Success Managers, Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services leadership, to resolve blockers, advocate for customer requirements, and maintain a unified one-team approach to delivery.

Experience

Minimum of 8+ years of experience in professional services, project management, program management, or a senior customer-facing delivery role within a high-growth technology environment.
Highly organized, with exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, dependencies, and executive stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated track record of leading high-profile, high-impact projects involving third-party partners, consultants, technical delivery teams, and complex multi-vendor ecosystems.
Experience managing strategic customer programs from kickoff through closeout, including project charters, governance cadences, risk management, change control, executive reporting, and lessons learned.
Sound business judgment, an ownership mindset, strong analytical capability, and a proven ability to influence results across global stakeholders.
Expert proficiency with Jira, Salesforce, Professional Services Automation (PSA), or equivalent project / portfolio management tools.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.
PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or related advanced project / program management certification is highly preferred.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. new_jobs.title: Onboarding Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Rentvine

Rentvine is the fastest-growing property management software company in the industry, ranked #60 on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list. Our powerful, cloud-based platform helps property managers streamline operations, reduce manual work, and deliver a better experience for tenants and owners. Behind that innovation is a team-first culture that puts people at the center. We care deeply about building a company where smart, driven individuals can grow, feel supported, and do the best work of their careers. Our people aren't just part of our success—they're the reason for it.

Please Note: Rentvine is unable to provide employment sponsorship now or in the future for this position. Candidates MUST currently reside in the USA to be considered.

About The Role

When a property management company decides to move to Rentvine, you're the person who gets them there. You'll run a full slate of implementations at once, and every one of them landing on time — with clean data and a client who actually knows how to use the platform — is on you.

This is a project management job first. You'll own the plan, keep everyone honest about their commitments, spot trouble before it turns into a missed date, and stay the one accountable person from kickoff to handoff. You'll scope work up front as needed and write the SOWs that define it — sometimes for your own projects, sometimes for a teammate's — and those calls are yours.

You won't be purely managing from a distance, either. You'll get into the data — building migration files, checking balances — working alongside our accounting and data specialists. Most of your time goes to running the project, but this isn't a role where you hand off a plan and watch.

What You'll Do

Own the project

Run a portfolio of client implementations end to end, from kickoff through go-live and the weeks after
Build project plans that actually hold up — sequencing discovery, data migration, configuration, training, and financial cut-over with realistic timelines
Confirm scope at kickoff and make sure the client knows what they owe you and when
Handle scope changes head-on: figure out the impact, walk the client through the tradeoff, get agreement. Don't just absorb it
Keep project status current and clear enough that a colleague could pick up your project cold

Scope the work and write the SOW

Scope incoming accounts — sometimes ones you'll run yourself, sometimes ones that go to a teammate. You're scoping for the team, not just your own slate
Get on the phone with people you've never met to do it. Often you'll be calling a prospect or a new client cold, with no relationship to lean on, and you'll need to pull real answers out of them fast
Size up the account: how much data, what condition it's in, what they're coming from, how complex their portfolio is, and how ready they actually are
Turn that into an estimate of effort and timeline you can stand behind — including when someone else will be the one delivering against it
Write SOWs that spell out what's included, what isn't, what we're assuming, what the client needs to do, and what "done" looks like — clear enough to settle an argument three months later
Write change orders when scope moves, with the timeline and effort impact quantified and the client signed off before the work starts
Make these calls yourself within your thresholds. Escalate when the commercial terms warrant it, not by default
Get involved with Sales on the complicated deals so we scope them right before signing, not after
Help build the templates and estimating standards so this gets more consistent over time

Keep it on track

Catch risks and slippage early, raise them, and fix them before a date slips
Hold internal teams and integration partners to their dates. These are dependencies, not favors
Run go-live readiness reviews against real exit criteria, and make the call on whether a client is ready
Close projects out properly and hand off to Customer Success with the context, open risks, and configuration decisions they need

Lead the client

Be the client's person throughout — one point of accountability, start to finish
Run the rhythm: kickoff, regular check-ins, milestone reviews, close-out
Chase what you need from the client side. Data, decisions, people's time. Escalate on their end when their delays put the date at risk
Say the hard things early. Timeline problems, scope creep, readiness gaps

Get the data right

Work with our accounting and data specialists on migration, validation, and financial cut-over, splitting the work based on how complex the project is and who's got capacity
Build migration files yourself when that's faster — mapping fields, cleaning up legacy exports, prepping data for load
Own the quality bar no matter who did the work. Review it closely enough to find the problems before the client does
Push what you learn back into the process, so we're not solving the same problem from scratch on every project

Qualifications

4+ years running customer-facing implementation, onboarding, or professional services projects — B2B SaaS ideally
Real experience scoping work and writing SOWs. We'll ask how you estimate, and what you learned the time you got it badly wrong
Comfort walking into a conversation cold. You'll be scoping accounts where you don't know anyone, sometimes before there's a signed deal, and you need to build enough trust in one call to get straight answers about their data and their operation
Experience carrying a full portfolio at once. Be ready to talk specifics: how many, how long they ran, how often you hit your dates
Solid project management fundamentals — scope, dependencies, critical path, risk tracking, change control, status reporting
You keep your project tool current. Not most weeks. Always
You can get people to deliver without managing them
Good judgment on scope and commercial tradeoffs, the backbone to hold a position with a client, and the sense to know when to escalate
Strong writing. SOWs, change orders, and status updates all fall apart when they're vague
Clear, calm communication out loud too, especially when the news isn't good
Comfortable in Excel and Sheets — lookups, conditional logic, cleaning up messy legacy exports — enough to build a migration file when you need to
Enough financial literacy to poke at a migration and know when something's off. You don't need to be an accountant; we have those

Even Better If You Have

PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, or similar
Property management industry or software background
Time in professional services or billable delivery, where sloppy scope hit the margin
Accounting, financial operations, or data migration experience
High-volume implementation environment where standardization was the goal
A track record of improving an implementation process, not just working inside one

What Success Looks Like

You hit your dates. Implementations launch on time or early
Your scope holds. Actual effort tracks close to what you scoped — on the projects you run and the ones you hand to someone else — and when it doesn't, it gets caught and turned into a change order instead of absorbed
No surprises. Status is accurate, and risks come up early rather than at the deadline
Clients get value fast. They're productive on Rentvine inside the target window
The data's clean. Balances reconcile at cut-over with no corrections after launch
Clients trust you. Strong satisfaction at close-out and a handoff to CS that leaves nothing hanging
They stick around. Customers are healthy through their first renewal

Committed to excellence in medical services, research, and education, University Health strives to improve health outcomes through innovative practices, community engagement, and a focus on health equity. The Senior Analyst position at University Health is a critical role within the Institute for Public Health, focusing on research, data analysis, and strategic reporting to support public health initiatives. The successful candidate will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, and synthesizing complex datasets to generate actionable insights that inform policy development, program planning, and community health strategies within Bexar County. This role requires a strategic thinker with a strong foundation in research design, data visualization, and statistical analysis, capable of transforming raw data into meaningful reports that influence decision-making processes. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. new_jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Reporting to the Manager, Cybersecurity Operations, the Senior Cybersecurity Operations Analyst is a key technical leader who supports cybersecurity operations, including incident response, threat monitoring, vulnerability management, operational process optimization, and risk-based guidance for IT and business stakeholders.

Beyond day-to-day operations, this role provides strategic input into security roadmap decisions and the development of operational playbooks and processes. The role also ensures that operational security practices align with business risks and compliance requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Security Incident and Service Request Management
Lead the analysis and resolution of complex cybersecurity incidents and service requests.
Conduct technical investigations and root cause analyses, and develop post-incident recommendations.

Monitoring and Event Analysis

Support and optimize cybersecurity platforms used for monitoring, detection, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and data protection.
Analyze security events, logs, vulnerability data, and anomalies to identify threats and risk exposure.
Translate technical findings into risk-based recommendations for IT and business stakeholders.

Vulnerability and Risk Exposure Management

Identify, assess, and prioritize vulnerabilities across IT, OT, cloud, and endpoint environments.
Coordinate remediation follow-ups with technical and business teams based on risk and asset criticality.
Track vulnerability KPIs, exceptions, risk acceptance decisions, and improvements to remediation processes.
Support cloud security posture management by assessing misconfigurations, identity risks, and exposure across cloud services.

Operational Process and Playbook Optimization

Maintain and improve incident response playbooks, operational procedures, and security processes.
Support operational readiness through exercises, testing, and alignment with industry standards and compliance frameworks.
Provide guidance on integrating security controls into IT and OT environments.

Cross-Functional Contributions

Act as a cybersecurity subject matter expert and support IT teams, projects, audits, and risk assessments.
Contribute to the security roadmap, technology evaluations, and security maturity improvements.
Support security awareness, stakeholder engagement, and after-hours response to high-severity incidents.

QUALIFICATIONS
ACADEMIC
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information security, or a related field.
Advanced industry certifications are strongly preferred, including CISSP, CISM, GIAC (GCIA, GCFA, or equivalent), Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), or other relevant cloud security certifications such as CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.

EXPERIENCE

Seven (7) years or more of experience in cybersecurity.
Demonstrated experience supporting cybersecurity operations, including incident response, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and continuous improvement of security processes.

SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Technical Skills

Advanced expertise with security monitoring and analysis tools, including SIEM, EDR, firewalls, and DLP solutions.
Strong knowledge of vulnerability and exposure management practices, including CVSS, exploitability, asset criticality, remediation service levels, compensating controls, exceptions, and risk acceptance workflows.
Hands-on experience with digital forensics, malware analysis, and advanced investigation techniques.
Strong knowledge of network protocols, Windows and Linux operating systems, and enterprise applications.
Strong knowledge of cloud security principles, including identity and access management, secure configuration, logging, and cloud security posture management.
Solid understanding of attack vectors, adversary tactics described in MITRE ATT&CK, and defensive strategies.
Familiarity with security architecture, asset classification, and risk management frameworks.
Ability to correlate vulnerabilities with asset criticality, threat intelligence, and business impact.

Non-Technical Skills
Demonstrated ability to lead during high-severity incidents and drive a coordinated response.
Strong communication skills with executives, technical teams, and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to mentor and coach colleagues outside the security function, fostering awareness and a strong security culture.
Analytical and decisive, with the ability to translate technical risks into business impacts.
Resilient under pressure and committed to organizational success.
Results-oriented and committed to team success.

LANGUAGES

Fluent in English, both spoken and written, with the ability to produce professional technical documentation and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

new_jobs.description:
Position Description

Minimum Education

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Minimum Experience

8

Summary

Directs the instrumentation and administration of cybersecurity tools, appliances, and measures to protect the Board’s IT assets and ensure the Board’s ability to conduct its mission. Utilizes cybersecurity tools such as firewalls, proxies, intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, endpoint protection, and data analysis platforms as part of an integrated, defense in depth solution with a central security information and event management (SIEM) system and security orchestration tools. Develops an expert understanding of system architecture and the ability to identify security weaknesses that can be exploited to compromise a variety of systems used by the Board. Develops technical products and presents highly technical subjects to a variety of audiences ranging from non-technical senior leaders to highly technical subject matter experts. Directs collaboration with other cybersecurity professionals to develop and implement cybersecurity solutions that enable threat hunt activities. Independently provides technical and analytical assessments to support information security engineering decisions to ensure Board information and systems are adequately protected.

Duties And Responsibilities

Directs and/or participates in implementing cybersecurity tools such as firewalls, proxies, intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, endpoint protection, and data analysis platforms as part of an integrated defense in depth solution with a central security information and event management (SIEM) system and security orchestration tools. Directs the development of technical and analytical assessments to support information security engineering decisions to ensure Board information and systems are adequately protected. Able to oversee characterization and management of complex risks to mitigate cyber threats.
Independently and proactively supports analysis of threat intelligence from a variety of sources to understand the nature of the threat, extract the information that informs threat hunt operations, and uses that information to investigate Board IT assets for evidence of an intrusion or compromise.
Independently emulates threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures in a controlled and/or production environment to demonstrate and observe the technical aspects of the emulated activity. Oversees the development of adequate detection strategies and development of mitigations as needed to address the specific details of the threat.
Directs the development of programs that apply statistical models, mathematical principles, and other analytic tradecraft to a variety of IT network-generated data for the purposes of identifying anomalous activity, suspicious network activity, and ultimately leads to the discovery of intrusions and/or compromises.
Independently identifies and analyzes system-generated logs and captures forensic images of a variety of systems for the purposes of fully analyzing a cybersecurity intrusion and/or compromise. Includes use of subject matter expertise to perform root cause analysis and develop timelines to show the actions taken by a cyber threat actor in an environment. Directs the completion of all phases of the incident response process including identification, containment, eradication, and remediation.
Directs the implementation of vulnerability scans and ensures operational systems are adequately patched to protect the Board from potential cyber threat actors. Directs the analysis of vulnerabilities and proof of concept code as it becomes available to assess the technical implications of a given threat and ensure that the Board’s defenses are sufficient. Maintains expert knowledge of ethical hacking principles to apply the skills to the management of vulnerabilities and mitigation of technical risk. Ensures that vulnerabilities are managed and patched according to Board policies and procedures.
Directs the development of and/or develops data analytic software and cybersecurity scripts using a variety of programming and scripting languages to enable cybersecurity activities designed to defend the Board’s IT assets. Leads the development of programs, software, and scripts that automate the cybersecurity process. Leads the development of data queries and scheduled jobs designed to correlate data for further analysis. Leads the integration of tools and systems for advanced analysis of relevant data.
Independently manages cybersecurity projects focused on developing and instrumenting highly complex, new, and innovative approaches to detect, prevent, and respond to cybersecurity intrusions and/or compromises. Authors documents and oversees the execution of project plans, schedules, requirements, risks, assumptions, cost, performance, and resource utilization.

Position Requirements

FR-28 Minimal Qualifications

Requires a bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity or a related business technology field and eight years of experience. Must have expert knowledge in the in at least one of the following areas: general cybersecurity fundamentals, cyber threat analysis, data science principles, digital forensics, incident handling, incident management, incident response, vulnerability management, security engineering, automation and programming, project management, and relevant technologies and programming languages. Must be able to work effectively with staff. Must be familiar with relevant policies, procedures, and be able to work with TOP SECRET / SENSITIVE COMPARTMENTED INFORMATION. Must be able to direct one or more of the following: providing threat assessments, recommending cybersecurity technologies for intrusion detection and prevention, assessing technical vulnerabilities, identifying automation opportunities, investigating, and resolving security breaches, technical writing, and communication.

Remarks:
This Principal Cybersecurity Analyst is an individual contributor position responsible for leading the instrumentation and administration of cybersecurity tools, appliances, and measures to protect the Board’s IT assets and ensure the Board’s ability to conduct its mission. The Principal Cybersecurity Analyst implements cyber incident response processes and procedures, contains and evicts cybersecurity intruders, and recovers the network after a confirmed cybersecurity incident. This includes triage of potential incidents, performing technical analysis to confirm incidents, and performing digital forensic investigations where appropriate. The Principal Cybersecurity Analyst will conduct operations in a hybrid environment consisting of a traditional datacenter footprint and a multi-cloud presence. The Principal Cybersecurity Analyst will perform coordination activities and will be expected to perform hands-on technical analysis of logs from servers, hosts, network appliances, and cloud infrastructure as needed, and on a case-by-case basis. The Principal Cybersecurity Analyst will also be expected to engage with internal and external stakeholders, lead the incident response process, and mentor junior staff on cybersecurity practices.

This position requires a TOP SECRET / SENSITIVE COMPARTMENTED INFORMATION security clearance.

Applicants are required to provide a writing sample of original work.

Highly Desirable

Expert knowledge in at least one of the following areas: cybersecurity operations, cyber threat analysis, intrusion detection & prevention, digital forensics, incident handling, incident management, incident response, vulnerability management, security engineering, and/or automation.
Ability to provide threat assessments, recommend cybersecurity technologies for intrusion detection and prevention, assess technical vulnerabilities, identifying automation opportunities, investigate and resolve security breaches.
Experience using cybersecurity tools such as firewalls, proxies, intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, endpoint protection, data analysis platforms, a SIEM, and/or security orchestration tools.
Experience with incident response tools and processes including host forensics, network forensics, log analysis, timeline development, memory acquisition and analysis, image acquisition, etc.
Experience analyzing threat intelligence from a variety of sources to understand the nature of a threat, extract the information that informs threat hunt operations, and uses that information to investigate Board IT assets for evidence of an intrusion or compromise.
Familiarity with relevant policies, procedures, and ability to work with TOP SECRET / SENSITIVE COMPARTMENTED INFORMATION.
Demonstrated resourcefulness and advanced critical thinking skills to independently direct, analyze, and implement solutions for all the various complex problems that arise in the administrative and operations area.
Expert technical writing and communications skills. Contacts are often with division leadership, but also with staff at all levels; a significant degree of coordination and contact with other units/sections/divisions may also be required.
Ability to construct clear and concise written work and applies an increasingly advanced understanding of grammar, sentence structure, and intended audience(s) to the process of writing and editing such work.
Ability to explain to cross-team or cross-divisional partners items of high levels of complexity.
Possess skills in negotiation and persuasion in performing duties and influencing support for change.

The expected salary range for this role is $144,500 - $275,400. Final offers are determined by experience and education, as well as internal and external factors.

new_jobs.description:
Description

As an ACES Process Manager focused on DEA (Delivery Experience Accuracy) Process Excellence, you will own the end-to-end identification, analysis, and resolution of delivery promise failures across Brazil's fulfillment network. Beyond data — you will connect the numbers to real-world operations, finding root causes where packages fail, designing corrective actions, and implementing sustainable improvements that protect 130M+ annual customer promises.

You will apply Lean Six Sigma methodology (DMAIC) to systematically reduce DEA defects across all owners: Planning Systems, FC Execution, Linehaul, Sort Center, Air, AMZL, and Commercial Carriers. You will lead cross-functional improvement projects, manage stakeholders across 10+ teams, and drive accountability through structured governance mechanisms.

Key job responsibilities

Leading root cause analysis for DEA failures using structured problem-solving (5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA, FFaLS logic)
Owning DMAIC projects targeting the highest-impact defect buckets (Planning Systems, Last Mile, FC Execution, Linehaul)
Connecting data patterns to physical process failures — understanding how a "Rolled Freight" in the data maps to a real truck departure issue at the FC
Designing and implementing corrective actions (process changes, system configurations, SOP updates) with measurable impact on DEA
Building and maintaining Control Plans (SPC, OCAP) to sustain improvements and detect regressions early
Leading Kaizen events and War Rooms during Sev1/Sev2 DEA events, coordinating containment and permanent fixes
Managing the DEA governance cadence: daily callouts, weekly reviews, monthly goals reporting
Identifying waste (Muda) and variation in the promise-to-delivery chain and proposing structural improvements
Driving cross-functional alignment between Planning Systems, FC Ops, Transportation, and Last Mile teams to close systemic gaps
Benchmarking Brazil DEA processes against other geographies (MX, NA, EU) to identify best practices

A day in the life

You will start your day reviewing yesterday's DEA performance — identifying which nodes, carriers, or programs missed target. You will then dive deep into the top offenders, walking the Gemba (virtually or physically) to understand what went wrong operationally. You will present findings in the daily War Room, propose countermeasures, and track implementation.

Your Week Includes Cross-functional Meetings With

FC Operations (GRU9, REC3, CWB1) for FC Execution issues
ATS Linehaul & Sort Center teams for middle-mile failures
AMZL (DSP, Flex, Hub) for last-mile delivery failures
Planning Systems & Tech (F2P, Promise, ATROPS) for systemic/configuration issues
Finance for impact quantification and business case development

About The Team

Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) is a team of highly qualified individuals responsible for the quality, productivity, safety, and speed of Amazon Operations. The DEA program within ACES owns the governance and continuous improvement of delivery promise accuracy — ensuring that when Amazon commits a delivery date to a customer, we deliver on that promise.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
Experience running an effective operational excellence program
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Experience in program or project management
Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
Experience with root cause analysis methodologies (5-Why, Fishbone, FMEA)
Intermediate level in Spanish

Preferred Qualifications

Lean-Six Sigma Black Belt certification
Experience in operational logistics/supply chain, manufacturing, transportation, general management or an engineering role
Knowledge of SQL
Experience with SPC (control charts, process capability analysis, OCAP)
Experience managing cross-functional improvement programs with 5+ stakeholder teams
Postgraduate degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or MBA
Experience with Amazon operational systems (PerfectMile, ATROPS, FMC, SSP) is a strong plus

Position Description & Qualifications

Serco is excited to continue our support for the F-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.

The F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) is a joint, multi-national program and is the Department of Defense’s (DoD) focal point for defining affordable next generation strike aircraft weapon systems among the United States (U.S.) Air Force (USAF), U.S. Navy (USN), U.S. Marine Corps (USMC), and U.S. allies currently composed of seven (7) cooperative international partners: the United Kingdom, Italy, Netherlands, Canada, Australia, Denmark, and Norway; as well as Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The F-35 is the next generation strike fighter bringing cutting-edge technologies to the battle-space of the future. The F-35’s advanced airframe, autonomic logistics, avionics, propulsion systems, stealth, and firepower will ensure that the F-35 is the most affordable, lethal, supportable and survivable aircraft ever to be used by so many warfighters around the world. The JPO is a product-aligned organization comprised of Program Management Offices (PMOs) designed to deliver five major products across the acquisition lifecycle: Air Vehicle, Propulsion, Combat Data Systems, Training Systems & Simulation, and Maintenance Systems.

Our Senior Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst
, located at Crystal City, VA, supports the F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) International Directorate (ID), Foreign Military Sales (FMS), in in acting as the focal point for all F-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the Joint Strike Fighter (JSF) Program Office and are responsible for providing day-to-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the FMS USG Program Managers who represent the FMS Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day-to-day representation of the cognizant FMS nation on all matters related to the F-35 Program.

You will be part of a dynamic team of F-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who work closely with the customer and other key F-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F-35 systems.

In This Role You Will

International Integration and support – assist ID in facilitating the programs of two types of countries associated with the F-35 program: “Partners” (also referred to as “Participant”), –who are signatories to the JSF Production, Sustainment and Follow-on Development Memorandum of Understanding (JSF PSFD MOU), and “FMS Customers,” which have a signed Letters of Requests (LORs) and Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs) for purchasing aircraft, related material, and services.
International Programs –
Assist ID in supporting National Deputies and their assistants in representing each of the F-35 Partner nations resident in ID.
Assist ID in supporting Service Deputies and their assistants in representing each of the F-35 US Services resident in ID.
Assist the USG Program Manager (PM) in representing each FMS customer and managing the F-35 LOA that is the foundation of each FMS country’s F-35 program.
Assist FMS PMs, Service Deputies and USG Partner country managers in leading USG activities and Program Management Reviews (PMRs) for each country in the F-35 Program to ensure each program remains on track.
Assist the New Business team within ID, in conjunction with industry and other USG security cooperation entities, in providing and coordinating F-35 information to countries considering acquiring the F-35, and in assisting in the USG effort to build a LOA for aircraft acquisition.

International Agreements –
Assist ID in the development, management, negotiation, and implementation of International Agreements, to include MOUs (such as JSF SDD MOUs [2001] and JSF PSFD MOU and in implementing arrangements, and LOAs.
Assist ID in coordinating the review and approval of Decision Memoranda by all Partners

Coordinated Capabilities –
Assist ID in serving as a cross-PMO coordination focal point for ID country requirements, PMR action items and ongoing, non-U.S. development, sustainment, and production challenges.
Assist ID in maintaining ID Scorecards and coordinating the positions of ID customers to the JPO.

External Interfaces – assist ID in coordinating with U.S. agencies on any programmatic or policy matter pertaining to the USG’s F-35 cooperative and FMS programs established with ID countries.
International Communication –
Assist ID in maintaining open lines of communication and maximum transparency between the F-35 program and external stakeholders (i.e., industry and international Ministries of Defense) with and through Partner National Deputies and FMS Foreign Liaison Officers (FLOs).

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Have

The ability to provide onsite support at the F-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) located at Crystal City, VA, a minimum of 2 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.
An active DoD Secret Security clearance.
A Master’s degree plus 5 years of recent work experience related to international acquisition programs or at least 10 years of aircraft operational experience.
OR a Bachelor’s degree plus 4 years of additional work experience (total of 14 years of experience).

Experience in defense acquisition program management related to weapon systems acquisition and life-cycle management.
Familiarity with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5000.2, DoD Directive (DODD) 5530.03 (International Agreements), and the International Cooperation in Acquisition, Technology and Logistics (IC in AT&L) Handbook.
Demonstrated knowledge of the principles, policies, and practices of system acquisition to plan, organize, and coordinate critical aspects of the development, production, deployment, and sustainment of systems, subsystems, and equipment.
Demonstrated knowledge of the Security Assistance/Security Cooperation (SA/SC) programs to include the understanding of the FMS sales process from case development, implementation, execution, to closure in accordance with the Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM), DoD 5105.38-MX.
The ability to travel up to 25% (CONUS/OCONUS).

Additional Desired Experience And Skills

Experience of creating products and working in Microsoft Office Suite- Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel (data types, formulas and functions in the workbooks), Microsoft Powerpoint, Microsoft Outlook, and Microsoft TEAMS.
Familiarity with foreign disclosure, releasability, and technology protection considerations.

Company Overview

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world.
