Job Summary

Barnes & Noble is the leading book retailer in the United States, with roots dating back to 1873 and a long history of growth through innovation and expansion. Today, under CEO James Daunt and private ownership by Elliott Advisors, Barnes & Noble operates approximately 700 bookstores nationwide, serves over 700 communities across all 50 states, and maintains a robust digital presence through BN.com, NOOK® eBooks and audiobooks, and educational resources such as SparkNotes. The company also includes complementary retail brands such as Paper Source, Books Inc., Tattered Cover, and B. Dalton, further strengthening its market reach. Following a period of revitalization, Barnes & Noble is experiencing strong momentum, with plans to open approximately 60 new stores in 2026, underscoring renewed confidence in physical retail and local bookselling. Combining expansive store networks, curated selections, enhanced in-store experiences, and growing omnichannel capabilities, Barnes & Noble remains the #1 bookseller in the U.S. and a trusted, evolving partner within the publishing and retail ecosystem.

An employee in this position can expect an annual salary between $60,000 - $68,000 depending on experience, seniority, geographic locations, and other factors permitted by law.

The Inventory Operations Analyst is responsible for ensuring Distribution Center (DC) product is handled efficiently, timely and accurately to support fast and reliable shipments to stores and ecommerce customers. This is accomplished by troubleshooting obstacles created by vendors, mismatched data or warehouse limitation. The Inventory Operations Analyst is also responsible for the liquidation of obsolete and surplus inventory within our Distribution Centers. This role partners cross functionally to drive efficient processes for the Distribution Centers, proactively identifying, creating, and implementing processes, procedures, and tools that reduce DC capacity constraints, maximize labor efficiency, reduce costs, and improve speed while maintaining accuracy. Their tasks and responsibilities contribute to the overall DC cycle time goals, increasing speed to market and supporting a dependable and reliable distribution process by spending time working and observing our warehouse operation.

Position Responsibilities

Oversees special order management workload, including key new releases, top priority items, author events, and manipulates DC-to-Store order allocations to achieve in-store dates and fill rate goals, while controlling DC freight costs.
Demonstrates strong analytical skills to effectively solve daily problems related to trouble receiving inventory and QC results.
Organizes special projects for merchandise remediation, roll outs, destruction/MOS, price ticketing, and stock balancing; initiating cost recovery when appropriate.
Partners with merchandise vendors to address operational non-compliance and consistently drives Vendor behavior to a place of compliance.
Works proactively with B&N’s Merchandising teams to strategize successful and timely launches of top priority items, initiatives and new product types.
Effectively analyzes data and processes to create reports, process maps and visualizations to illustrate issues (bottlenecks, costs, wasted labor) and opportunities for improvement (efficiencies, savings).
Resolves Customer Service, ICS, and HO escalations related to DC inventory and shipments.
Facilitates efficiencies in receiving/shipping of DC inventory.
Creates and modifies the necessary tools to recommend actions needed in volume times.
Responsible for new/closing store merchandise and related internal processes, ensuring outbound accuracy and timeliness.
Ensure Business Development special handling order needs are met, communicating any exceptions.
Contributes to our B&N Vendor Operational Guidelines to drive vendor compliance and establish procedures for best practices with gains in efficiency.
Achieves inventory health by curating lists of obsolete items/surplus inventory to be exited with merchant approval, and determines the appropriate exit strategy for the selected inventory; bulk/individual sale, donation, used book annex, etc.
Additional job duties or responsibilities may be assigned.

Position Requirements

Exercises sound judgment to effectively solve problems.
Works collaboratively with others to meet the needs of the organization.
Follows up to ensure all work requirements are completed in a timely and accurate manner.
Must be team-oriented and customer-focused.
Must contribute effectively and professionally in meetings (in person or virtual) with cross-functional partners and vendors.
Prioritizing and multi-tasking.
Works with a sense of urgency while maintaining high quality standards.
Adhere to all safety protocols and foster a safe work environment.
Work on the warehouse floor which includes regular lifting, bending, reaching, pulling and pushing of 10 -35 lbs. with an occasional 50 lbs., and ability to stand for extended periods of time as needed.

Position Qualifications

Knowledge and understanding of the retail supply chain.
Publishing or book selling experience.
Strong communication and analytical skills.
Familiarity with social media and third-party sales outlets.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access).
Bachelor’s degree in a related field and/or 3-5 years of related work experience.
Business operations experience is a plus.

Expected Behaviors

Well-organized and manages time efficiently.
Makes decisions based on sound logic.
Adapts well to changing situations, prioritizing and multi-tasking.
Team oriented and customer focused.
Dependable, receives and executes tasks to completion.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships across all levels of the organization.
Display a positive and respectful attitude.
Collaborate with team members to provide top-notch results.

If you love high profile and challenging projects supporting the US Army, then Serco has a great opportunity for you!

Perform analysis and analytics to produce algorithms and/or business process recommendations.
Use data, algorithms, and analyses to identify and apply mechanisms to both overcome impediments to materiel readiness and exploit opportunities to improve readiness through feasible, cost-effective software and business process improvements, changes, and interventions.
Address complex analytical challenges and identify the challenges and opportunities within systems, develop comprehensive solutions, and incorporate these capabilities solutions into software and workflows.
Develop analytics and process solution sets, the criteria for recommended algorithms and processes shall include preference for efficient methods that use as simple of a process as possible given the current state-of-the-art practices. The analytics and process solution sets shall provide appropriate, economic savings-driven answers.

Use appropriate qualitative analytics techniques to include multi-criteria decision analysis, qualitative comparative analysis, causal mapping, formal game theory, minimax procedures (game theory), decision architecture, systems architecture analysis, organizational analysis and structural reform, supply chain analysis, and multinational best practices (military and industry) evaluation.
Use logistics and agent-based modeling and simulation.
Conduct business process analysis and optimization across the Doctrine, Organization, Training, Materiel, Leadership, Education, Personnel, Facilities, Policy (DOTMLPF-P) spectrum and beyond.

Experience creating meaningful data visualizations and interactive dashboards using platforms such as Excel, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, RShiny, plotly, and d3.js to communicate findings and relate them back to how your insights create business impact.
Working knowledge of databases and SQL.
Superior communication skills, both oral and written.

Experience developing software to generate reports and visualizations that summarize data sets and provide data-driven insights.

Establish the programme structure, governance model and delivery cadence.
Translate strategic objectives into an integrated programme roadmap and plan.

programme outcomes and scope;
projects and workstreams;
milestones and delivery gates;
roles and accountabilities;
governance and decision forums;
escalation routes.

Manage programme-level:
scope and milestones;
dependencies and critical paths;
resources and capacity;
costs and forecasts;
risks, assumptions, issues and decisions;

Experience managing programme risks, resources, costs, forecasts and executive reporting.

new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Technical Project Manager (Compliance & Certifications) to coordinate, manage, and drive our technical compliance, security, and industry certification initiatives. In this role, you will be the operational engine behind our compliance roadmap—managing the rigid timelines of external audits while aligning execution across internal software development, IT/TechOps, and business operations cycles.

As a key member of our execution team, you will ensure that all compliance projects are structured, tracked, and reported in strict accordance with our corporate PMO Standards.

You will directly own and manage the planning, tracking, and execution of our annual Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation and SOC2 (Type 1 and Type 2) audits. This role provides the critical project management, compliance oversight, governance, and auditability necessary to keep all teams aligned and audit-ready.

Key Responsibilities

PMO Reporting & Project Standards
PMO Standards Alignment: Manage and structure all compliance, security, and certification project plans, trackers, and document repositories in accordance with established PMO methodologies and guidelines.
Standardized Status Reporting: Provide routine, structured progress reports, KPI dashboards, and project health updates (covering milestones, risks, and blockers) as defined by PMO reporting frameworks.
Risk & Issue Escalation: Actively track dependencies and risks, executing formal escalation paths per PMO standards when compliance milestones are in jeopardy.
Platform Management: Maintain up-to-date program trackers, schedules, and resource planning artifacts within central PMO tools (such as Asana or Jira) to ensure a single source of truth.
Hybrid Project Management & Governance
Milestone & Critical Path Tracking: Establish clear, phase-gate project plans for upcoming audits, mapping out the critical path for audit readiness, dry-runs, evidence lock-down, and formal evaluation windows.
Requirements Translation: Translate complex, rigid compliance controls (e.g., security protocols, data-filtering standards) into clear, actionable technical specifications, user stories, and development tasks.
Engineering Alignment: Partner with Security, TechOps, Data, and Engineering teams to slot compliance-related tasks and vulnerability remediations into active development cycles (sprints or Kanban) without disrupting the core product roadmap.
Cross-Functional Compliance Oversight: Oversee key operational controls managed by technical partner teams to ensure continuous audit readiness.
Audit Coordination & Evidence Gathering
Audit Liaison: Serve as the primary operational contact and liaison for external auditors and assessors (e.g., MRC, EY, SOC2 auditors), ensuring meetings, requests, and inquiries are managed efficiently.
Evidence Management: Project manage the continuous gathering, formatting, and submission of technical evidence (configurations, access logs, architectural diagrams) required for SOC2 and MRC evaluations.
Remediation Tracking: Monitor and drive the resolution of any compliance gaps, audit findings, or vulnerability remediation tasks identified during pre-audits or continuous monitoring.
Media Rating Council (MRC) Certification Support
Audit Lifecycle Management: Project manage the end-to-end timeline for annual MRC audits, pre-assessment phases, and ongoing compliance reviews.
Adtech & Measurement Standards: Coordinate engineering and product tasks related to data pipelines, measurement methodologies, and filtration logic to ensure strict alignment with MRC and industry measurement standards.
Disclosure & Change Governance: Coordinate the preparation, maintenance, and regular updating of methodology disclosures, and establish a "Journal of Change" process to manage and communicate changes to accredited elements with MRC and auditor representatives.
Business Operations Alignment: Project manage compliance workflows across business operations required by MRC standards, including Business Partner Qualification (BPQ/client vetting), client onboarding/support disclosures, and discrepancy/data reissuance tracking.
SOC2 Type 1 & Type 2 Support
Audit Execution: Organize the schedule, operational execution, and readiness milestones for annual SOC2 Type 1 and Type 2 audits.
Controls Integration: Partner with engineering and IT teams to ensure system monitoring, access control reviews, and infrastructure configurations are consistently maintained and documented according to SOC2 Trust Services Criteria.
Automation Management: Help manage and monitor compliance automation tooling (e.g., Vanta, Drata) to ensure continuous control verification and evidence tracking.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience: 5 years of experience as a Technical Project Manager, Program Manager, or Delivery Manager in a SaaS, Adtech, or software engineering environment.
PMO Alignment: Proven experience managing projects and reporting project health, timelines, and status updates in alignment with structured PMO frameworks.
Hybrid PM Expertise: Demonstrated ability to manage fixed-deadline, structured compliance timelines (milestone/waterfall approach) while integrating execution into Agile-operating engineering teams.
Compliance & Governance: Practical experience managing projects, timelines, evidence gathering, or compliance oversight related to SOC2 audits or Media Rating Council (MRC) accreditation.
Project Tracking Platforms: Advanced proficiency in structured project planning and execution tracking within platforms like Asana or Jira.
Technical Literacy: Comfort working alongside engineering and IT teams; ability to understand cloud infrastructure concepts (AWS/GCP), database schemas, and identity/access management frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

Adtech Background: Deep understanding of ad-serving technology, measurement methodologies, and industry measurement standards.
Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional), CAPM, PMI-ACP, or introductory security/compliance credentials.
Compliance Tooling: Experience using compliance automation platforms (e.g., Drata, Vanta, Secureframe) to track control verification and evidence gathering.

US Benefits & Perks

Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
Regular company events and activities
Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
401k Plan – 4% employee match
Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success.
